value.background: Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next scheduled hard fork after Pectra and Fusaka, with published estimates pointing to mainnet in 2026 and its confirmed headliners being EIP-7732 (enshrined proposer-builder separation) and EIP-7928 (block-level access lists). EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 would raise the cost of creating and accessing state so that fees better reflect resource consumption under a proposed throughput scaling plan — the changes at the centre of the cancelled test.
value.background_en: Glamsterdam is Ethereum's next scheduled hard fork after Pectra and Fusaka, with published estimates pointing to mainnet in 2026 and its confirmed headliners being EIP-7732 (enshrined proposer-builder separation) and EIP-7928 (block-level access lists). EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 would raise the cost of creating and accessing state so that fees better reflect resource consumption under a proposed throughput scaling plan — the changes at the centre of the cancelled test.
value.background_zh: Glamsterdam是以太坊在Pectra和Fusaka之后的下一个计划中的硬分叉，公开预测指向2026年上线主网，已确认的核心内容包括EIP-7732（内嵌提议者-构建者分离）和EIP-7928（区块级访问列表）。EIP-8037与EIP-8038则拟提高创建和访问状态的gas成本，使费用更贴近实际资源消耗，属于一项吞吐量扩容计划的组成部分——也正是此次被取消的测试所涉及的核心改动。
value.detailed_summary:
Ethereum's second and final Glamsterdam hard fork testnet on Hoodi was cancelled this week after ChainSecurity found vulnerabilities in the gas-scaling EIPs 8037 and 8038 that could break at least 13 DeFi contracts when a call runs out of gas. Researchers at Eth Labs and the Ethereum Foundation independently spun up AI agents to scan contracts for the flaws, then set up a shared message board in the form of a GitHub repo to coordinate the agents' work.

The cancellation postpones the dress rehearsal for an upgrade that Ethereum DeFi operators depend on, and Eth Labs' Derek Chiang said protocols designers should in future do "much more thorough analysis of potential breakages" much earlier in the process. He added that the agent exercise proved effective enough that a second board has been opened to study EIP-8198, or "Quick Slots", proposed for the follow-up Hegota fork.

Chiang said the vulnerability was found "a few minutes to midnight," causing everyone to scramble, and the Hoodi testnet is not expected to be rescheduled until all of the fork's second-order effects have been properly analyzed. He likened the setup to the OpenAI–Hugging Face hack, where rogue agents coordinated through a message board, noting "the same pattern is useful for the good agents too."

value.detailed_summary_zh:
以太坊Glamsterdam硬分叉的第二个、也是最后一个测试网Hoodi本周被取消，原因是ChainSecurity发现gas扩容类以太坊改进提案EIP-8037与EIP-8038存在漏洞，可能导致至少13个DeFi合约在调用耗尽gas时出错。Eth Labs与以太坊基金会的研究人员各自独立部署了一批AI代理来扫描合约漏洞，随后以GitHub仓库的形式搭建了一个共享“留言板”，用于协调这些代理的工作。

此次取消使得一次关键升级的“彩排”被迫延后，而该升级是以太坊DeFi运营方所依赖的基础设施。Eth Labs的Derek Chiang表示，未来协议设计者应当在流程更早的阶段“对可能引入的破坏做更彻底的分析”。他还表示，AI代理的排查方式成效显著，因此已开设第二个留言板，用于研究拟纳入后续Hegota分叉的EIP-8198（“Quick Slots”）。

Chiang称该漏洞是在“临近午夜的最后几分钟”被发现的，导致所有人紧急应对；在分叉的所有二阶影响被充分推演之前，Hoodi测试网预计不会重新排期。他把这一做法类比于OpenAI与Hugging Face被攻击事件中恶意代理通过留言板协同行动的情形，并表示“同样的模式对‘好代理’同样有用”。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through the upgrade timeline rather than a live exploit: the flaw surfaced during a Hoodi testnet rehearsal, but DeFi contracts that rely on current gas behavior face review before the fork can be rescheduled. A delay to Glamsterdam also defers the expected effects of enshrined proposer-builder separation and block-level access lists on block building and staking economics.
value.market_impact_zh: 影响传导主要经由升级时间表，而非已发生的攻击：漏洞是在Hoodi测试网演练中暴露的，但依赖当前gas行为的DeFi合约需先接受排查，分叉才能重新排期。Glamsterdam的延后也会推迟内嵌提议者-构建者分离与区块级访问列表对区块构建和质押经济模型本应产生的影响。

S&P Global has been expanding its digital asset coverage, and the deal pairs OpenZeppelin's onchain security tooling with S&P Global's institutional client network and global distribution.

value.detailed_summary:
S&P Global said on October 26, 2026 that it has completed its acquisition of blockchain security firm OpenZeppelin, a deal first announced on September 17, 2026, with financial terms undisclosed. OpenZeppelin will operate as a standalone business unit led by founder Demian Brener, who reports to S&P Global Ratings president Yann Le Pallec.

S&P Global said the deal complements its digital asset risk assessment business and is meant to help traditional financial institutions and onchain firms evaluate smart contract and underlying technology risk. The company said it does not expect the transaction to have a material impact on its financial results.

OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015, provides smart contract audits, secure development services and open-source contract libraries; its security team says it has completed more than 900 audits and found over 10,000 vulnerabilities before product launch. S&P Global said OpenZeppelin Contracts will remain open source, free and publicly maintained, and that the cumulative value transferred through the libraries exceeds $38 trillion.

value.background: Polkadot is a proof-of-stake network designed to connect multiple blockchains, created by Ethereum co-founder Gavin Wood and developed mainly by Parity Technologies with support from the Web3 Foundation. Fearless Wallet is one of several third-party wallets serving that ecosystem, and its extension is promoted as offering fast performance and secure account storage on Kusama and Polkadot.

value.detailed_summary:
The Polkadot Foundation issued a warning that the Fearless Wallet browser extension leaked users' private keys, leaving affected wallets exposed to compromise. The warning names the third-party Polkadot-ecosystem wallet directly.

Private keys are what authorize transfers from a wallet, so anyone holding a leaked key can move the associated funds without further approval from the owner.

Fearless Wallet's browser extension is built for the Kusama and Polkadot networks and distributed through the Chrome Web Store for Chrome and Chromium-based browsers. The warning as reported did not include confirmed loss figures, exploit scale, or the number of affected users.

私钥是钱包发起转账的授权凭证，因此任何拿到泄露私钥的人都可以在无需所有者进一步批准的情况下转走对应资金。

Fearless Wallet 浏览器扩展面向 Kusama 和 Polkadot 网络，通过 Chrome 应用商店分发给 Chrome 及基于 Chromium 的浏览器用户。就目前报道的警告内容而言，并未包含已确认的损失金额、漏洞利用规模或受影响用户数量。
value.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through the custody channel rather than the protocol: DOT and KSM holders who used the extension face direct key-compromise risk, and the episode puts attention on the security posture of third-party wallets across the Polkadot and Kusama ecosystem. Polkadot's relay chain itself is not implicated in the warning.

value.detailed_summary:
Janus Henderson announced it will launch JQQQ, billed as the first licensed tokenized fund tracking the Nasdaq 100, built with Centrifuge's tokenization infrastructure and deployed on the Stellar blockchain, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The fund will initially be open to eligible professional investors outside the United States, with a minimum investment of $100,000.

The launch extends Janus Henderson's onchain products beyond US Treasurys and structured credit into equity-index exposure; the asset manager said its institutional onchain strategies now exceed $1 billion.

JQQQ is structured as a segregated portfolio of a British Virgin Islands investment company and provides indirect exposure to the Nasdaq 100 rather than ownership of the underlying stocks. The fund operates under a licensing agreement with Nasdaq.

据《华尔街日报》报道，Janus Henderson 宣布将推出 JQQQ，并称这是首只获得纳斯达克 100 指数授权的代币化基金；该基金采用 Centrifuge 的代币化基础设施，部署在 Stellar 区块链上。基金初期面向美国境外的合格专业投资者开放，最低投资金额为 10 万美元。

此举将 Janus Henderson 的链上产品从美国国债和结构化信贷扩展至股票指数敞口；该资产管理公司称，其机构链上策略规模已超过 10 亿美元。

JQQQ 是设立于英属维尔京群岛的投资公司旗下的独立投资组合，提供对纳斯达克 100 指数的间接敞口，而非持有成分股。该基金依据与纳斯达克签署的授权协议运作。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through tokenized RWA infrastructure: Stellar and Centrifuge gain a major asset manager as an issuer, which could draw further institutional issuance to that chain. The reach is narrow for now — the fund is limited to non-US professional investors with a $100,000 minimum — and XLM traded near $0.17 on Tuesday, down about 16% year to date, indicating that growth in onchain RWA value has not carried over into the network token.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于代币化 RWA 基础设施：Stellar 与 Centrifuge 由此获得一家大型资产管理公司作为发行方，可能为该链带来更多机构发行。但目前覆盖面有限——基金仅面向非美国专业投资者、门槛为 10 万美元——而 XLM 周二在 0.17 美元附近交易，年内下跌约 16%，显示链上 RWA 规模的增长尚未传导至该网络代币。

SEAL 911 is a free, around-the-clock emergency hotline run by the Security Alliance that connects projects facing active or imminent security incidents with security researchers for exploit triage and fund recovery.
value.background_zh: swETH 是用户在 Swell Network 质押 ETH 后获得的流动性质押代币，代表已质押的 ETH 及累计收益，可用于 DeFi。rswETH 是 ERC-20 流动性再质押代币，使用户在 ETH 被再质押至 EigenLayer 等协议时仍保持流动性，属于价值重定（repricing）型代币，其价值反映带收益的再质押 ETH。SEAL 911 是由 Security Alliance 运营的免费全天候应急热线，为遭遇正在发生或即将发生的安全事件的项目对接安全研究人员，用于漏洞研判与资金追回。
value.detailed_summary:
Swell, a liquid staking and restaking protocol, has suspended deposits and withdrawals for its swETH liquid staking token and rswETH liquid restaking token, saying it is working with security partners and SEAL 911 to fully remediate its infrastructure. The team said its next step is to restore NAV (net asset value) to the correct level, after which it will reopen deposits and withdrawals.

Suspending both deposits and withdrawals freezes user exit paths, leaving holders of swETH and rswETH unable to redeem on the protocol while the issue is investigated. Swell stated that all user funds are safe.

Swell said the day before that it had noticed reports of suspicious activity involving the swETH and rswETH contracts. The team warned that phishing attacks tend to increase during such incidents and urged users to rely only on official channels.

value.background: The product extends a crypto build-out in which SoFi returned to consumer crypto trading in November 2025, subsequently launched the SoFiUSD stablecoin and brought it to its consumer app in May; SoFi Crypto now supports more than 40 crypto assets. Cointelegraph reported in May that SoFi planned interest-bearing tokenized deposits alongside SoFiUSD. The launch came a day after the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a final rule covering payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January. CEO Anthony Noto said the aim is for funds to keep generating yield before they are used, combining bank deposit yield and protection with the speed and utility of digital assets.

The launch came a day after the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a final rule covering payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January. CEO Anthony Noto said the aim is for funds to keep generating yield before they are used, combining bank deposit yield and protection with the speed and utility of digital assets.
value.background_zh: 该产品延续了 SoFi 的加密业务扩张：公司于 2025 年 11 月重返面向消费者的加密交易，随后推出 SoFiUSD 稳定币，并于今年 5 月将其接入消费端 App，目前 SoFi Crypto 支持超过 40 种加密资产。Cointelegraph 今年 5 月曾报道，SoFi 计划在推出 SoFiUSD 的同时提供计息代币化存款。此次发布前一天，美国货币监理署（OCC）发布了涵盖支付稳定币发行及部分托管活动的最终规则，GENIUS 法案框架将于明年 1 月中旬生效。CEO Anthony Noto 表示，目标是让资金在被使用前持续产生收益，把银行存款的收益与保护同数字资产的速度与效用结合起来。
value.detailed_summary:
SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched SoFi Earn (ticker SOFIE), a tokenized deposit issued by SoFi Bank that pays a variable 4.40% annual percentage yield, carries no minimum balance requirement, and qualifies for FDIC coverage up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category. SoFi describes it as the first tokenized deposit offered directly to consumers by a US national bank and expects the rollout to SoFi Crypto members to be completed in November.

Each SOFIE corresponds to $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank and can be converted one-for-one into SoFiUSD, the bank's dollar-pegged stablecoin, to buy crypto in the app or send to supported external wallets — giving crypto users a bank-backed, deposit-insured way to hold idle dollars before they are deployed.

SOFIE deposits continue to earn interest until they are converted, whereas SoFiUSD itself, like other stablecoins, is not an FDIC-insured deposit. Members reach the separate SOFIE deposit account through their SoFi Crypto account.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
SoFi Technologies 于周四推出 SoFi Earn（代码 SOFIE），这是由 SoFi Bank 发行的代币化存款，提供 4.40% 的可变年化收益率，无最低余额要求，并在每位存款人、每家受保银行、每个账户所有权类别 25 万美元限额内获得 FDIC 保险保障。SoFi 称这是美国国民银行首次直接面向个人客户提供代币化存款，并预计 11 月完成向 SoFi Crypto 会员的全面上线。

每枚 SOFIE 对应 SoFi Bank 的 1 美元存款，可按 1:1 兑换为该行的美元挂钩稳定币 SoFiUSD，用于在应用内购买加密资产或转至支持的外部钱包，为加密用户在动用资金之前持有闲置美元提供了一种银行背书且受存款保险保障的方式。

SOFIE 存款在兑换前持续计息，而 SoFiUSD 与其他稳定币一样，本身并不属于受 FDIC 保险保障的存款。会员通过其独立的 SoFi Crypto 账户访问该 SOFIE 存款账户。
value.market_impact_en: Yield-bearing, deposit-insured bank tokens compete for the stock of idle on-chain dollars that would otherwise sit in stablecoins, a channel that runs through stablecoin issuers' float and the bank deposits backing them. The launch also adds a consumer-facing bank instrument to a tokenized-money segment where commercial-bank deposit tokens are being positioned as a regulated alternative to e-money tokens.
value.market_impact_zh: 计息且受存款保险保障的银行代币将与原本以稳定币形式持有的闲置链上美元形成竞争，其传导渠道涉及稳定币发行方的浮存规模及其背后的银行存款。此次发布也为代币化货币领域增添了一个面向消费者的银行产品，而该领域中商业银行存款代币正被定位为电子货币代币的受监管替代方案。

value.detailed_summary:
Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for tokenized US stocks and ETFs issued by EQX Labs, covering S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers (EQSPY, EQQQQ) plus single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX. The tokens are already registered on Hyperliquid mainnet, but matching will not open until 21:30 Beijing time on October 26 (9:30 a.m. ET the same day).

The listing adds a tokenized-equity asset class to one of the largest on-chain derivatives venues, extending on-chain trading in major US stocks and index trackers beyond conventional market hours. Trading has not yet begun, so liquidity and any regulatory response remain untested.

EQX says each token is backed 1:1 by real shares but is legally structured as a limited-recourse debt note issued by a segregated portfolio company in the British Virgin Islands rather than direct share ownership, and is not offered to US persons.

value.background: Brotli is a lossless compression algorithm developed by Jyrki Alakuijala and Zoltán Szabadka, combining LZ77, Huffman coding and second-order context modeling, and it is commonly offered as an HTTP content-encoding. CVE-2026-111497 was previously reported as a Brotli decoder flaw in Node.js, and researchers demonstrated a proof of concept on the official Node.js 24.22.0 Linux arm64 image by feeding crafted data to the bundled Brotli decoder.
value.background_en: Brotli is a lossless compression algorithm developed by Jyrki Alakuijala and Zoltán Szabadka, combining LZ77, Huffman coding and second-order context modeling, and it is commonly offered as an HTTP content-encoding. CVE-2026-111497 was previously reported as a Brotli decoder flaw in Node.js, and researchers demonstrated a proof of concept on the official Node.js 24.22.0 Linux arm64 image by feeding crafted data to the bundled Brotli decoder.
value.background_zh: Brotli 是由 Jyrki Alakuijala 与 Zoltán Szabadka 开发的无损压缩算法，结合了 LZ77、霍夫曼编码与二阶上下文建模，常被用作 HTTP 内容编码。CVE-2026-111497 此前被报道为 Node.js 中 Brotli 解码器的缺陷，研究人员曾向官方 Node.js 24.22.0 的 Linux arm64 镜像内置的 Brotli 解码器投喂构造数据，成功演示了概念验证利用。
value.community_discussion: Commenters pushed back hard on the "HTTP2Shell" name, calling it broad and undescriptive and preferring "Broccoli2Shell" for the same vulnerability, noting it can be triggered through manual Brotli decoding without HTTP at all. Others questioned the severity framing: one commenter said the surprising part is how many implementations support Brotli-compressed request bodies, while another complained the coverage is sensationalized and does not make clear how many projects are affected in common configurations versus other, less critical uses of Brotli.
value.community_discussion_en: Commenters pushed back hard on the "HTTP2Shell" name, calling it broad and undescriptive and preferring "Broccoli2Shell" for the same vulnerability, noting it can be triggered through manual Brotli decoding without HTTP at all. Others questioned the severity framing: one commenter said the surprising part is how many implementations support Brotli-compressed request bodies, while another complained the coverage is sensationalized and does not make clear how many projects are affected in common configurations versus other, less critical uses of Brotli.
value.community_discussion_zh: 评论者对“HTTP2Shell”这一命名提出强烈质疑，认为它过于宽泛、未能描述实际问题，更偏好用“Broccoli2Shell”指代同一漏洞，并指出即使不经过 HTTP、只要手工做 Brotli 解码也可能触发。也有人质疑严重性叙事：一位评论者称，真正令人意外的是竟有这么多实现支持 Brotli 压缩的请求体；另一位则抱怨报道过度渲染，且没有说清有多少项目是在常见配置下受影响，而不是 Brotli 的其他（虽有问题但远没那么严重）用法。
value.detailed_summary:
The Brotli decoder vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-111497, previously publicized as "Node2Shell," is now being circulated under the name "HTTP2Shell," with reporting describing it as an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw whose blast radius extends across many HTTP libraries and applications rather than only Node.js. The Aikido write-up states that vulnerable Node.js versions are flagged in repositories and container images.

The flaw sits in Brotli decoding, a compression path used widely in HTTP handling, so exposure is not limited to a single runtime; Vercel said its WAF has rules in place to detect and block exploitation attempts against the vulnerability.

A researcher comment in the discussion thread noted that Ubuntu still lists the libbrotli1 patch as under review at medium severity, which is holding up updates to libcurl and, in turn, git and other packages. Commenters also questioned why a fix reportedly shipped in February was not treated as a security issue at the time.
value.detailed_summary_en:
The Brotli decoder vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-111497, previously publicized as "Node2Shell," is now being circulated under the name "HTTP2Shell," with reporting describing it as an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw whose blast radius extends across many HTTP libraries and applications rather than only Node.js. The Aikido write-up states that vulnerable Node.js versions are flagged in repositories and container images.

The flaw sits in Brotli decoding, a compression path used widely in HTTP handling, so exposure is not limited to a single runtime; Vercel said its WAF has rules in place to detect and block exploitation attempts against the vulnerability.

A researcher comment in the discussion thread noted that Ubuntu still lists the libbrotli1 patch as under review at medium severity, which is holding up updates to libcurl and, in turn, git and other packages. Commenters also questioned why a fix reportedly shipped in February was not treated as a security issue at the time.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
编号为 CVE-2026-111497 的 Brotli 解码器漏洞此前以“Node2Shell”之名传播，如今又以“HTTP2Shell”的名义流传；相关报道称这是一个无需认证即可远程执行代码的漏洞，影响范围覆盖大量 HTTP 库与应用，而不只是 Node.js。Aikido 的文章称，其检测能力可以在代码仓库和容器镜像中标记出受影响的 Node.js 版本。

该漏洞位于 Brotli 解码环节，而这一压缩路径在 HTTP 处理中被广泛使用，因此受影响面并不局限于单一运行时；Vercel 表示其 WAF 已部署规则，用于检测并阻断针对该漏洞的利用尝试。

讨论中有评论者指出，Ubuntu 仍将 libbrotli1 的补丁标注为“审核中”、严重级别为中等，这拖慢了 libcurl 乃至 git 等一系列软件包的更新。也有评论者质疑：据称 2 月就已发布的修复，当时为何未被当作安全问题处理。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission path is operational rather than price-driven: crypto services, node operators and self-hosted RPC or API infrastructure commonly run Node.js and other HTTP stacks built on libbrotli/libcurl, and a distro patch still under review leaves that dependency chain unpatched until maintainers ship updates. Exposure depends on whether internet-facing services enable Brotli-compressed request handling and on how quickly operators apply upstream fixes.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径更多体现为运营风险而非价格驱动：加密服务、节点运营方以及自托管的 RPC 或 API 基础设施普遍运行 Node.js 以及基于 libbrotli/libcurl 的其他 HTTP 栈，而发行版补丁仍在审核中，意味着在维护者发布更新前这条依赖链仍处于未修补状态。实际暴露程度取决于面向公网的服务是否启用了对 Brotli 压缩请求体的处理，以及运营方采用上游修复的速度。

value.detailed_summary:
SpaceX and Tesla are reportedly exploring a merger that would consolidate their corporate bitcoin holdings into a single entity holding more than 30,000 BTC. One report put the combined figure at 30,221 bitcoin.

A combination would pool two of the largest corporate bitcoin holders in the world onto a single balance sheet, making the merged company one of the biggest corporate owners of BTC.

The talks are described as an early-stage exploration rather than an agreed transaction, with no terms, timing or regulatory review disclosed. Reported figures for the combined holdings differ, with some coverage citing nearly 20,000 bitcoin and other reports citing 30,221 BTC.

value.background: Before Alpenglow, Solana relied on TowerBFT for consensus and Turbine for block propagation, alongside Proof of History. Votor is described as a stateless, explicit voting structure inspired by the Streamlet protocol, designed for fast finality with minimal complexity. Alpenglow is described as the biggest overhaul of Solana's consensus mechanism since the network's 2020 mainnet launch.
value.background_en: Before Alpenglow, Solana relied on TowerBFT for consensus and Turbine for block propagation, alongside Proof of History. Votor is described as a stateless, explicit voting structure inspired by the Streamlet protocol, designed for fast finality with minimal complexity. Alpenglow is described as the biggest overhaul of Solana's consensus mechanism since the network's 2020 mainnet launch.
value.background_zh: 在 Alpenglow 之前，Solana 依靠 TowerBFT 达成共识、依靠 Turbine 传播区块，并配合历史证明（Proof of History）机制。Votor 被描述为一种无状态的显式投票结构，灵感来自 Streamlet 协议，旨在以最小复杂度实现快速最终确定。Alpenglow 被认为是 Solana 自 2020 年主网上线以来对其共识机制最大的一次改造。
value.detailed_summary:
Solana activated its Alpenglow consensus overhaul on mainnet, replacing the TowerBFT consensus mechanism with Votor and the Turbine block-propagation protocol with Rotor. The change cuts block finality from roughly 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.

According to Solana, Alpenglow is the network's first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT, changing how validators vote and how blocks reach finality. A finality time of roughly 150 milliseconds instead of about 12.8 seconds directly shortens the wait for transaction confirmation on the network.

Solana states the upgrade leaves transaction execution and the SVM unchanged, altering only consensus-related mechanics and how consensus information is exposed to downstream infrastructure. Rotor, like Turbine, erasure-codes each block into smaller "shreds" that can be reconstructed from a subset.

Solana 已在主网激活 Alpenglow 共识升级，用 Votor 替换原有的 TowerBFT 共识机制，并用 Rotor 替换 Turbine 区块传播协议。此次变更将区块最终确定时间从约 12.8 秒缩短至约 150 毫秒。

据 Solana 介绍，Alpenglow 是该网络自 TowerBFT 以来首次重大共识替换，改变了验证者的投票方式以及区块达成最终确定的方式。最终确定时间从约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒，直接缩短了网络上的交易确认等待时间。

Solana 表示，此次升级不改动交易执行和 SVM，只改变与共识相关的机制以及共识信息向下游基础设施的暴露方式。Rotor 与 Turbine 一样，会将每个区块通过纠删码拆分为更小的“碎片”（shreds），并可从其中一部分碎片重建完整区块。
value.market_impact_en: Solana is one of the largest layer-1 networks, so cutting finality to roughly 150 milliseconds affects the confirmation workflows that exchanges, bridges and DeFi applications build around SOL deposits, withdrawals and settlement. The upgrade is a change to network infrastructure and user experience rather than to token supply or custody arrangements.
value.market_impact_zh: Solana 是规模最大的第一层网络之一，将最终确定时间压缩至约 150 毫秒，会影响交易所、跨链桥和 DeFi 应用围绕 SOL 充值、提现与结算所建立的确认流程。此次升级改变的是网络基础设施和用户体验，而非代币供应或托管安排。

value.background: A Lightning invoice is a signed payment request generated by the recipient that commits to a payment hash, with the recipient releasing the corresponding preimage once paid. BOLT11 is the long-standing invoice format, and implementations depend on consistent parsing of its fields to determine whether a payment has settled.
value.background_en: A Lightning invoice is a signed payment request generated by the recipient that commits to a payment hash, with the recipient releasing the corresponding preimage once paid. BOLT11 is the long-standing invoice format, and implementations depend on consistent parsing of its fields to determine whether a payment has settled.
value.background_zh: 闪电网络发票是由收款方生成并签名的支付请求，其中承诺一个支付哈希，收款方在收到付款后公开对应的原像（preimage）。BOLT11 是长期使用的发票格式，各实现依赖对其字段的一致解析来判断一笔支付是否已完成。
value.detailed_summary:
Lightning developers tightened BOLT11, the Lightning Network's invoice standard, on Oct. 19, requiring software to reject invoices with ambiguous, missing or repeated payment-hash and payment-secret fields. The change follows a developer's account of an attack that made completed Bitcoin withdrawals appear unpaid.

Invoices with ambiguous payment-hash or payment-secret fields could let a completed payment be presented as unpaid, so requiring implementations to reject them removes that ambiguity at the protocol-standard level.

The change was merged into BOLT11, the invoice specification that Lightning wallets and nodes use to encode payment requests including the destination, amount, payment hash and expiry. The reported incident was described in a developer's account and has not been confirmed as a large-scale exploit.
value.detailed_summary_en:

The change follows a developer's account of an attack that made completed Bitcoin withdrawals appear unpaid.

Invoices with ambiguous payment-hash or payment-secret fields could let a completed payment be presented as unpaid, so requiring implementations to reject them removes that ambiguity at the protocol-standard level.

The change was merged into BOLT11, the invoice specification that Lightning wallets and nodes use to encode payment requests including the destination, amount, payment hash and expiry. The reported incident was described in a developer's account and has not been confirmed as a large-scale exploit.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
闪电网络开发者于10月19日收紧了其发票标准 BOLT11，要求软件拒绝包含含糊、缺失或重复的支付哈希（payment hash）与支付密钥（payment secret）字段的发票。此举源于一名开发者披露的一起攻击事件：该攻击使已完成的比特币提现显示为未支付。

支付哈希或支付密钥字段存在歧义的发票，可能让已完成的支付被呈现为未支付；要求各实现拒绝此类发票，便在协议标准层面消除了这一歧义。

该修改已被合并进 BOLT11——闪电网络钱包和节点用来编码支付请求（包含目标节点、金额、支付哈希和有效期）的发票规范。相关事件源自一名开发者的描述，尚未被确认为大规模漏洞利用。
value.market_impact_en: The exposure sits with Lightning-enabled withdrawal paths — exchanges, custodial services and self-hosted wallets that reconcile payouts via BOLT11 invoices — where ambiguous fields could complicate settlement reporting. The rule change constrains implementation behavior rather than token supply or liquidity.

value.background: zkVMs are virtualized environments that produce zero-knowledge proofs of the code they execute, letting computation run off-chain while only a succinct proof is submitted on-chain. Succinct's SP1 was introduced as a performant, 100% open-source, contributor-friendly zkVM, and is used for blockchain scalability use cases such as reducing on-chain costs and increasing throughput.

Succinct's SP1 was introduced as a performant, 100% open-source, contributor-friendly zkVM, and is used for blockchain scalability use cases such as reducing on-chain costs and increasing throughput.

value.detailed_summary:
Succinct patched a soundness vulnerability in its SP1 zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) that could have allowed invalid zero-knowledge proofs to be accepted as valid, according to The Defiant.

A soundness flaw in a proving system breaks the core guarantee that an accepted proof corresponds to correct computation, so any system relying on SP1 proofs to validate state transitions would inherit that risk.

SP1 is Succinct's open-source zkVM that verifies the execution of programs written in Rust or other LLVM-compiled languages. The specific version affected, the discovery timeline and the patch details were not disclosed in the available material.

证明系统中的可靠性缺陷会破坏一项核心保证：被接受的证明应对应正确的计算；因此，任何依赖 SP1 证明来验证状态转换的系统都会继承这一风险。

SP1 是 Succinct 推出的开源 zkVM，用于验证以 Rust 或其他可编译为 LLVM 的语言编写的程序执行过程。现有材料未披露受影响的具体版本、漏洞发现时间线及补丁细节。
value.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through the security assumptions of zk-based infrastructure rather than through any token: rollups, bridges and applications that verify SP1 proofs depend on soundness, so disclosure of such a flaw affects confidence in that proving stack and may shape how teams assess and diversify their proving dependencies.

value.detailed_summary:
OpenAI is nearing the close of a new funding round in which it is seeking to raise up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion pre-money valuation, with investors from the UAE co-leading alongside investment firm Coatue, according to CNBC-sourced reports. OpenAI told investors on Thursday that it aims to sign the agreements by the end of next week, though the final size of the round is still being determined.

Should the round price OpenAI above a $1 trillion valuation, it would become the most highly valued private company on record. The company is positioning the raise as an "opportunistic bridge financing" ahead of a possible initial public offering.

The $1.25 trillion figure is a pre-money valuation, meaning it excludes the new capital being raised. OpenAI also is negotiating a commercial agreement to obtain additional computing resources from the UAE, and CFO Sarah Friar has previously told employees the company could list in 2027.

value.background: TowerBFT had been Solana's consensus mechanism since the network launched in March 2020. Alpenglow's design was published in May 2025 by Anza's research team led by ETH Zurich professor Roger Wattenhofer with Quentin Kniep and Kobi Sliwinski. Before mainnet, the protocol went through public testing including red teaming, penetration testing, repeated migration rehearsals and a security competition, followed by testnet and devnet launches. Further upgrades — Rotor for block data propagation, geographically aware leader rotation, and a post-quantum research design called Quantumglow — are planned but have no committed dates.

value.background_zh: TowerBFT 自 2020 年 3 月 Solana 网络启动以来一直是其共识机制。Alpenglow 的设计由 Anza 研究团队于 2025 年 5 月发表，团队由苏黎世联邦理工学院教授 Roger Wattenhofer 带领，成员包括 Quentin Kniep 和 Kobi Sliwinski。在上主网之前，该协议经历了公开测试，包括红队测试、渗透测试、多次迁移演练和一场安全竞赛，随后在测试网和开发者网上线。后续升级还包括改变区块数据传播方式的 Rotor、地理感知的领导者轮换，以及抗量子研究设计 Quantumglow，但均未公布确定时间表。
value.detailed_summary:
Anza announced that Alpenglow, Solana's new consensus protocol, is now live on mainnet-beta, retiring TowerBFT. The switchover took place at genesis slot 459,653,000, activated at epoch 1064, with 654 validators participating and a handoff that took 900 milliseconds, cutting transaction finality from about 12.8 seconds to roughly 150 milliseconds.

The change targets finality — the point at which a transaction can no longer be reversed and the moment an exchange, bank or merchant waits for before treating an asset as moved. Anza CEO Brennan Watt called it "the largest, most ambitious blockchain upgrade since 'The Merge,'" saying the team took it from white paper to mainnet in under 18 months.

Validators approved the upgrade in September 2025, voting 98% in favor of SIMD-0236, the implementing proposal; Anza shipped the protocol in Agave, its validator client, and independent operators coordinated a shared handoff point on the running network while carrying the existing ledger forward. The design is intended to keep working with less than 20% of stake acting maliciously and a further 20% offline, gradually lengthening block times if the network goes 10 seconds without finalizing a block.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Solana 客户端开发团队 Anza 宣布，新共识协议 Alpenglow 已在 Solana 主网（mainnet-beta）上线，原有共识机制 TowerBFT 正式退役。此次切换发生在创世槽位 459,653,000、于第 1064 个纪元激活，共有 654 个验证者参与，切换耗时 900 毫秒，交易最终确认时间由约 12.8 秒缩短至约 150 毫秒。

此次升级改变的是“最终性”——即交易不可再被回滚的时间点，也是交易所、银行或商户在认定资产已转移之前等待的时刻。Anza 首席执行官 Brennan Watt 称其为“自‘The Merge’以来规模最大、最具雄心的区块链升级”，并表示团队在不到 18 个月内将其从白皮书推进到主网。

验证者已于 2025 年 9 月批准该升级，以 98% 的赞成票通过了实施提案 SIMD-0236；Anza 在其维护的验证者客户端 Agave 中实现了该协议，并由独立运营者在运行中的网络上协调统一的切换点，同时沿用既有账本。该设计旨在在低于 20% 质押份额作恶、另有 20% 离线的情况下仍可运行；若网络连续 10 秒未能出块最终化，验证者将逐步延长出块时间。
value.market_impact_en: The upgrade directly affects Solana's base-layer settlement speed, the channel through which exchanges, custodians and payment processors decide when a SOL or token transfer counts as settled; shorter finality could change deposit-crediting and withdrawal policies on centralized venues and reduce the confirmation wait baked into on-chain trading and bridging flows. It also alters validator vote mechanics, since votes are now sent directly between validators and weighted by stake rather than written into later blocks, which bears on validator operations and staking economics.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次升级直接影响 Solana 底层结算速度，而结算速度正是交易所、托管机构和支付处理方判断 SOL 或代币转账何时算作已完成的依据；最终性缩短可能改变中心化平台的充提确认策略，并压缩链上交易与跨链流程中的等待时间。升级同时改变了验证者的投票机制——投票不再写入后续区块，而是由验证者之间直接发送并按质押权重计算——这关系到验证者运维与质押经济模型。

value.background: Kalshi Prime is a US futures commission merchant regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that provides execution, clearing and prime brokerage services for derivatives and event-based financial products; Kalshi launched it in June and appointed former CFTC Division of Clearing and Risk head Jeff Bandman as CEO on 12 August. The GENIUS Act is the US federal stablecoin statute governing permitted payment stablecoin issuance, and regulators including the OCC and Treasury have been issuing implementing rules.
value.background_en: Kalshi Prime is a US futures commission merchant regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that provides execution, clearing and prime brokerage services for derivatives and event-based financial products; Kalshi launched it in June and appointed former CFTC Division of Clearing and Risk head Jeff Bandman as CEO on 12 August. The GENIUS Act is the US federal stablecoin statute governing permitted payment stablecoin issuance, and regulators including the OCC and Treasury have been issuing implementing rules.
value.background_zh: Kalshi Prime 是美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的期货佣金商，为衍生品和事件类金融产品提供执行、清算和主经纪商服务；Kalshi 于今年 6 月推出该实体，并于 8 月 12 日任命 CFTC 清算与风险部前负责人 Jeff Bandman 为首席执行官。《GENIUS 法案》是美国联邦层面的稳定币立法，规定了合规支付稳定币的发行要求，OCC 与财政部等监管机构正在陆续出台实施细则。
value.detailed_summary:
Kalshi has reached an agreement with crypto custodian BitGo that will let clients of Kalshi Prime — its CFTC-registered futures commission merchant — borrow against digital assets held in custody and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading on Kalshi. Bloomberg reported the arrangement, which uses a tri-party collateral management structure in which loans are made by Kalshi's affiliated lending company Kalshi Katalyst and collateral sits at BitGo Bank & Trust.

Kalshi Prime CEO Jeff Bandman said the arrangement is intended to let clients take trading positions without exiting their crypto holdings, and that it may attract crypto-native trading firms and large holders of digital assets.

Eligible collateral includes bitcoin, ether and stablecoins deemed compliant with the GENIUS Act, with additional custodians expected to be added later. Kalshi launched gold, silver and crypto perpetual contracts earlier this year and has applied to list perpetual-style products tied to oil and US equities.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Kalshi has reached an agreement with crypto custodian BitGo that will let clients of Kalshi Prime — its CFTC-registered futures commission merchant — borrow against digital assets held in custody and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading on Kalshi. Bloomberg reported the arrangement, which uses a tri-party collateral management structure in which loans are made by Kalshi's affiliated lending company Kalshi Katalyst and collateral sits at BitGo Bank & Trust.

Kalshi Prime CEO Jeff Bandman said the arrangement is intended to let clients take trading positions without exiting their crypto holdings, and that it may attract crypto-native trading firms and large holders of digital assets.

Eligible collateral includes bitcoin, ether and stablecoins deemed compliant with the GENIUS Act, with additional custodians expected to be added later. Kalshi launched gold, silver and crypto perpetual contracts earlier this year and has applied to list perpetual-style products tied to oil and US equities.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Kalshi 与加密资产托管机构 BitGo 达成协议，将允许其在美国注册的期货佣金商 Kalshi Prime 的客户以托管的数字资产作为抵押借款，并把贷款资金用作 Kalshi 交易所杠杆永续期货交易的保证金。据彭博社报道，该安排采用三方抵押品管理结构，贷款由 Kalshi 关联借贷公司 Kalshi Katalyst 提供，抵押资产存放于 BitGo Bank & Trust。

Kalshi Prime 首席执行官 Jeff Bandman 表示，该安排旨在让客户无需退出加密资产持仓即可参与交易，并可能吸引加密原生交易机构及持有大量数字资产的巨鲸。

合格抵押资产包括比特币、以太坊，以及被视为符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，预计后续还将接入其他托管机构。Kalshi 今年早些时候已推出黄金、白银及加密货币永续合约，并已申请推出与石油和美股挂钩的永续类产品。
value.market_impact_en: The channel is leverage and collateral mobility: crypto held at BitGo can now back margin on a CFTC-regulated venue without being sold, which may reduce the need for institutional holders to liquidate spot positions to fund derivatives exposure. The explicit inclusion of GENIUS-compliant stablecoins ties the margin base to the regulated stablecoin perimeter, though the facility is limited to Kalshi Prime clients and is not systemic in scale.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是杠杆与抵押品流动性：存放于 BitGo 的加密资产如今无需卖出即可为 CFTC 监管场所的保证金提供支持，这可能降低机构持有者为衍生品敞口而清算现货的需求。明确纳入符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，则把保证金基础与受监管稳定币范畴绑定；不过该安排仅面向 Kalshi Prime 客户，规模上尚不具系统性。

value.background: Full-duplex speech models process incoming audio while generating speech, allowing overlapping dialogue and dynamic turn-taking rather than strict turn-based exchanges. The NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 is a liquid-cooled, rack-scale system that links 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs via NVLink-C2C, introduced as part of NVIDIA's Blackwell platform.

value.background_zh: 全双工语音模型在生成语音的同时处理输入音频，从而支持对话重叠和动态轮流发言，而非严格的轮流对话。NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 是液冷机架级系统，通过 NVLink-C2C 连接 36 颗 Grace CPU 与 72 颗 Blackwell GPU，属于 NVIDIA Blackwell 平台的一部分。
value.community_discussion: Hacker News commenters were struck by the claim of low-latency local inference on a MacBook Pro paired with single-rack training, calling it an impressive feat for smaller-scale AI work. Others pushed back on the demos, arguing the model interrupts too aggressively and the added laugh in the first sample felt artificial, and several raised concern that such voices would be hard to distinguish from humans on a fraudulent call.

value.detailed_summary:
Block announced Dessa, a full-duplex speech model that can listen and speak at the same time, describing it as the most authentic such model built to date. The company says it runs locally on a MacBook Pro M4 Max or better and was trained on a single NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system.

If the claims hold, combining natural interruption handling and low latency with local inference on a consumer laptop would mark a meaningful deployment step for voice AI, moving real-time spoken agents off cloud infrastructure. The release is a vendor announcement and has not been backed by third-party benchmarks.

Block presents the model as both highly expressive and low-latency, and highlights the training efficiency of using one GB200 NVL72 rack. No independent latency, quality or hardware-requirement measurements were provided with the announcement.

如果这些说法成立，把自然的打断处理与低时延和消费级笔记本上的本地推理结合起来，将是语音 AI 在部署层面的一次重要进展，使实时语音智能体不再依赖云端基础设施。不过该发布属于厂商公告，尚未有第三方基准测试支撑。

Any broader effect depends on whether voice-agent deployments shift toward on-device inference, which would reduce reliance on cloud voice infrastructure.

value.detailed_summary:
CryptoSlate published a report detailing how $37 million stolen from Americans was moved through a Bahamas-based bank and converted into Tether’s USDT.

The report adds a concrete case to a channel already documented by AML researchers: criminals using weak-KYC venues to convert stolen funds into stablecoins.

The report traces $37 million in stolen funds from U.S. victims through a Bahamas-based bank and into Tether’s USDT.

value.background: ENSv2's architecture was previously detailed on the ENS blog, which described hierarchical registries in which each name can provide its own registry implementation for managing subnames, giving name owners direct control over ownership and transfer rules. ENS is the Ethereum naming system that maps human-readable .eth names to wallet addresses and other resources; the ENS token is its governance asset.

ENS is the Ethereum naming system that maps human-readable .eth names to wallet addresses and other resources; the ENS token is its governance asset.
value.background_zh: ENS 此前在其博客中详细介绍过 ENSv2 的架构，其中提到分层注册表：每个域名都可以提供自己的注册表实现来管理子域名，让域名所有者直接掌控所有权与转移规则。ENS 是以太坊上的命名系统，负责把人类可读的 .eth 域名映射到钱包地址及其他资源，ENS 代币为其治理资产。
value.detailed_summary:
ENSv2 went live on the Ethereum mainnet on October 27, introducing hierarchical registries and a more granular permission model under which a single name can act as an independent on-chain registry, letting communities and organizations define their own subdomain issuance rules and delegate management by zone. The release also updates how names are resolved, adds support for shared record links, and ships a new ENS App for general users plus an ENS Explorer for developers.

ENS says its ecosystem now covers more than 36 million domains across over 600 applications, and that existing .eth domains will continue to work without re-registration, with users able to voluntarily upgrade to ENSv2 in the ENS App starting today. The permission changes shift control over subdomain rules and ownership management from a single global registry to individual name owners.

After upgrading all eligible domains, users can claim a commemorative ENSv2 NFT designed by artist Polyhop, one per wallet, subject to Ethereum network gas fees. 1inch, MetaMask, Safe, Uniswap, PayPal, Venmo and OpenSea are among the applications already adapting to ENSv2.

value.background: A liquidation is the automatic closure of a leveraged position once a trader's margin can no longer support the trade, which is why sharp moves can produce cascading forced selling. In derivatives markets, long liquidation data is tracked alongside open interest and funding rates to gauge how crowded leveraged positioning has become.

value.background_zh: 清算是指当交易者的保证金不足以支撑仓位时，杠杆头寸被自动强制平仓，因此剧烈波动往往引发连锁性的强制卖出。在衍生品市场中，多头清算数据通常与未平仓合约量、资金费率一起被用来衡量杠杆仓位的拥挤程度。
value.detailed_summary:
Bitcoin briefly traded below $80,000, triggering $404 million in liquidations of crypto long positions within a four-hour window, according to The Block. The move wiped out leveraged bullish bets as the price dipped under the $80,000 level before recovering.

The scale of the four-hour liquidation total indicates that a large volume of leveraged long positions had been built up near the $80,000 level, and their forced closure amplified the downward move.

The liquidation figure covers long positions only, over a four-hour window, and the sub-$80,000 break is described as brief. No exchange failure, insolvency or protocol-level disruption was reported alongside the deleveraging.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 The Block 报道，比特币一度短暂跌破 8 万美元，在四小时窗口内引发 4.04 亿美元的加密多头仓位清算。价格下探 8 万美元关口后回升，杠杆做多押注随之被集中平掉。

四小时内出现如此规模的清算，说明在 8 万美元附近积累了大量杠杆多头仓位，这些仓位的强制平仓放大了下跌幅度。

该清算数据仅统计多头仓位，时间跨度为四小时，且跌破 8 万美元被描述为“短暂”。此次去杠杆过程中，未见交易所故障、机构破产或协议层面中断的报道。
value.market_impact_en: The event is concentrated in bitcoin perpetual and futures markets, where forced long closures reduce open interest and can drain order-book liquidity around the $80,000 level; the read-through to spot and other crypto assets runs through leverage, not through custody or regulatory channels.

value.detailed_summary:
Anthropic has secured a total of $77 billion in additional financing from Google, Amazon and Broadcom, according to a BlockBeats report dated October 26. Each agreement carries its own conditions: Amazon's tranche is tied to Anthropic reaching specific compute-capacity milestones, while Google's $20 billion commitment is partly contingent on Anthropic meeting certain revenue targets.

The commitments tie Anthropic's funding directly to compute buildout and revenue performance, linking capital to measurable operational milestones rather than a single lump-sum investment. Google and Amazon have now collectively invested tens of billions of dollars in Anthropic and are its largest shareholders.

Of the total, Google's portion is a $20 billion commitment that is partly conditional on revenue targets; Amazon's agreement is structured around compute-capacity milestones. The report characterizes Google and Amazon as simultaneously investors in and competitors of Anthropic.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 26 日消息，Anthropic 已从谷歌、亚马逊和博通处获得总计 770 亿美元的额外融资。每项协议均附带各自条件：亚马逊的融资与 Anthropic 达到特定算力里程碑挂钩，谷歌的 200 亿美元承诺则部分取决于 Anthropic 能否实现特定营收目标。

这些承诺将 Anthropic 的资金与算力建设和营收表现直接绑定，使资本投放与可衡量的运营里程碑挂钩，而非一次性投入。谷歌和亚马逊累计向 Anthropic 投资数百亿美元，已成为其最大股东。

在总额中，谷歌的部分为 200 亿美元承诺，部分取决于营收目标；亚马逊的协议则围绕算力容量里程碑设定。报道称，谷歌和亚马逊既是 Anthropic 的投资方，同时也是其竞争对手。
value.market_impact_en: The deal signals continued hyperscaler willingness to commit large, milestone-linked capital to frontier AI labs, a sentiment channel that typically feeds narratives around AI- and decentralized-compute-related crypto tokens. It also underscores how much AI compute demand is being routed through a small set of cloud and chip suppliers, a concentration that shapes the infrastructure backdrop AI-adjacent crypto projects benchmark against.

value.detailed_summary:
TechCrunch reported on October 22, 2026 that DeepSeek has raised $15 billion, described as one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology. The report is framed as unconfirmed, and the round's terms and investor list were not disclosed.

The timing puts the reported raise directly against Washington's national-security restrictions on DeepSeek's technology, a contrast China's government has already pushed back on after the Homeland Security Department's removal order.

The report did not disclose valuation, investor identities or whether the round has closed. Earlier coverage of DeepSeek fundraising described different figures, including a sought $7.35 billion round, indicating that reported totals have varied across outlets.

这一时点使该融资报道与华盛顿以国家安全为由对 DeepSeek 技术施加的限制形成直接对照；在国土安全部下达移除令后，中国政府已对此表示反对。

该报道未披露估值、投资方身份，也未说明融资是否已完成交割。此前关于 DeepSeek 融资的报道给出的数字并不一致，其中包括寻求 73.5 亿美元融资的说法，说明各家媒体所报道的总额存在出入。

value.background: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens intended to represent shares, which proponents say can allow fractional ownership and more flexible trading. In January 2026, SEC staff issued a statement on the taxonomies of tokenized securities, including the distinction between issuer-sponsored and third-party-sponsored models, and the agency has since weighed an innovation exemption for 24/7 trading pilots. Tokenized equities sit within the broader real-world asset (RWA) category tracked by data providers such as CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap.
value.background_en: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens intended to represent shares, which proponents say can allow fractional ownership and more flexible trading. In January 2026, SEC staff issued a statement on the taxonomies of tokenized securities, including the distinction between issuer-sponsored and third-party-sponsored models, and the agency has since weighed an innovation exemption for 24/7 trading pilots. Tokenized equities sit within the broader real-world asset (RWA) category tracked by data providers such as CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap.
value.background_zh: 代币化股票是用区块链代币来表示股票的工具，支持者认为它可以实现碎股持有和更灵活的交易。2026 年 1 月，SEC 工作人员就代币化证券的分类发布了声明，其中涉及发行方主导模式与第三方主导模式的区分，此后该机构还在考虑为 24 小时不间断交易试点提供创新豁免。代币化股票属于 CoinGecko、CoinMarketCap 等数据平台所追踪的广义“现实世界资产”（RWA）类别。
value.detailed_summary:
Tokenized stock trading is gaining volume in overseas jurisdictions, according to CNBC, while Goldman Sachs and other U.S. companies are objecting to the practice. The standoff sets up a fight over market structure and regulation for tokenized equities.

The objection from a major U.S. issuer raises the question of whether offshore venues can keep expanding tokenized share trading without the consent of the companies whose stock is being tokenized.

Under U.S. law, a tokenized instrument that meets the definition of an equity security remains subject to the federal securities laws, SEC regulations and FINRA requirements, according to a recommendation from the SEC's Market Structure Subcommittee. The CNBC report describes an evolving trend rather than a single ruling or enforcement action.

The objection from a major U.S. issuer raises the question of whether offshore venues can keep expanding tokenized share trading without the consent of the companies whose stock is being tokenized.

Under U.S. law, a tokenized instrument that meets the definition of an equity security remains subject to the federal securities laws, SEC regulations and FINRA requirements, according to a recommendation from the SEC's Market Structure Subcommittee. The CNBC report describes an evolving trend rather than a single ruling or enforcement action.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 CNBC 报道，代币化股票交易在海外司法辖区的成交量正在上升，与此同时高盛等美国公司对这一做法表示反对。双方的对立使代币化股票的市场结构与监管归属成为争议焦点。

一家美国主要发行方的反对，使一个关键问题浮出水面：离岸平台能否在未获得标的公司同意的情况下，继续扩大代币化股票交易。

根据美国证监会（SEC）市场结构小组委员会的一份建议文件，只要代币化工具符合股权证券的定义，就仍须遵守联邦证券法、SEC 法规以及美国金融业监管局（FINRA）的要求。CNBC 的报道描述的是一个正在演变的趋势，而非某一项裁决或执法行动。
value.market_impact_en: Growth in offshore tokenized equity trading feeds directly into the RWA segment that crypto venues and data providers already track, giving exchanges and stablecoin-based settlement rails exposure to equity-market volumes. Pushback from U.S. issuers could instead shift pressure toward regulators and shape how RWA products are structured and where they may be offered.
value.market_impact_zh: 离岸代币化股票交易的增长，直接作用于加密交易所和数据平台已在追踪的 RWA 板块，使交易平台和基于稳定币的结算通道获得了与股票市场成交量挂钩的敞口。而美国发行方的反对，则可能把压力转向监管机构，并影响 RWA 产品的结构设计及其可发行地区。

value.background_zh: CoinDCX 在 2025 年 7 月遭遇约 4400 万美元的黑客攻击，公司将其归咎于服务器被入侵，随后悬赏追回被盗资金，并有一名员工被捕。该交易所今年还面临欺诈与冒充诈骗的指控并引发警方调查；在 2025 年黑客事件后，其创始人否认了与 Coinbase 的收购谈判报道。CoinDCX 表示随着调查推进将披露更多细节。
value.detailed_summary:
CoinDCX said in a blog post that 15.99 million USDT (about $16 million) was drained on the Tron network on Oct. 21, after an internal process failed to sweep customer deposits out of wallets the exchange retired following its 2025 hack. The Mumbai-based exchange said it absorbed the loss itself and that customer funds remain safe, reversing CEO Sumit Gupta's earlier public claim that reports of a breach were a "false alarm."

The admission brings CoinDCX's losses from two incidents to nearly $60 million, following the roughly $44 million hack in July 2025. It also publicly reverses the CEO's denial, turning a disputed on-chain flag into a company-confirmed loss.

The retired wallets at the center of the loss were a legacy of the earlier breach and kept receiving residual deposits, which the failed automated transfer system left exposed. On-chain investigator ZachXBT disputed Gupta's account, noting the wallet in question had still been sweeping user deposits into CoinDCX's current hot wallet as recently as April and May, and urged customers to withdraw their assets.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
CoinDCX 在一篇博客文章中表示，10 月 21 日有 1599 万枚 USDT（约合 1600 万美元）在波场（Tron）网络上被转走，原因是内部流程未能将客户存款从其 2025 年黑客事件后停用的钱包中归集转出。这家总部位于孟买的交易所称已自行承担该损失、客户资金安全，这与其 CEO Sumit Gupta 此前公开称相关入侵报道是“虚惊一场”的说法相反。

此次损失涉及的钱包是此前那次入侵的遗留地址，仍不断收到残余存款，而失效的自动转账系统使这些资金处于暴露状态。链上调查者 ZachXBT 反驳了 Gupta 的说法，指出涉事钱包直到今年 4 月和 5 月仍在将用户存款归集到 CoinDCX 当前的热钱包，并呼吁客户提取资产。

value.background_en: USDC is issued by Circle. Circle Mint lets exchanges, institutional traders, banks and large financial institutions redeem USDC 1:1 for USD directly with Circle, and stablecoin redemption fees are charges applied when stablecoins are converted through an issuer or authorized redemption channel.
value.background_zh: USDC 由 Circle 发行。Circle Mint 允许交易所、机构交易员、银行和大型金融机构直接向 Circle 将 USDC 按 1:1 兑换为美元；稳定币赎回费是在通过发行方或授权赎回渠道兑换稳定币时收取的费用。
value.detailed_summary:
Circle introduced USDC auctions that let institutional holders provide or bid for exit liquidity and earn the fees paid by others cashing out.

The mechanism gives institutional holders a way to earn fees by supplying exit liquidity for USDC cash-outs, adding a fee-earning role alongside existing redemption channels.

Auction participants can take either side—supplying exit liquidity or bidding for it—while the fees paid by users cashing out go to the liquidity providers.

Circle introduced USDC auctions that let institutional holders provide or bid for exit liquidity and earn the fees paid by others cashing out.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Circle 推出了 USDC 拍卖机制，允许机构持有者提供或竞标退出流动性，并赚取其他人套现所支付的费用。

该机制让机构持有者可以通过为 USDC 套现提供退出流动性来赚取费用，在现有赎回渠道之外增加了一个可收费的角色。

拍卖参与者可以站在任一边——提供退出流动性或竞标退出流动性——而套现用户支付的费用由流动性提供方获得。
value.market_impact_en: The auctions target the market for large USDC redemptions, where exit liquidity and cash-out fees sit at the intersection of stablecoin liquidity and institutional treasury operations. The direct transmission is through USDC redemption channels rather than broad crypto asset prices.

value.background_zh: 汇丰于今年4月获得香港金管局（该市事实上的中央银行）颁发的稳定币发行人牌照，相关监管制度于2025年8月生效；截至当年9月，汇丰在至少36家竞争申请者中率先获批。汇丰于2026年9月30日正式公布RedCoin这一名称。其他银行也在争夺同一支付场景：去年9月，包括高盛和美国银行在内的21家贷款机构宣布计划联合推出美元稳定币，目标在2027年上半年上线。
value.detailed_summary:
HSBC launched RedCoin (ticker RCHKD), a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin licensed by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, on its PayMe app, with more than 3.3 million users able to activate wallets in the coming days to send money to friends or pay at over 100,000 PayMe merchants. The bank said it plans to add the token to its HSBC HK Mobile Banking app later this year.

The launch puts an HKMA-licensed stablecoin inside a major global bank's existing consumer wallet, letting Hong Kong users pay with blockchain-based money without opening a crypto exchange — a step beyond the trading-platform venues where stablecoins have mostly circulated.

RedCoin runs on HSBC's own private ledger rather than a public blockchain such as Ethereum, and balances cannot move between PayMe and HSBC's banking app; it is also not a bank deposit and is not covered by Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme. HSBC's reserve tracker showed roughly $10.2 million of RedCoin circulating shortly after launch, backed by $10.4 million held entirely in cash, with the first independent attestation of reserves expected after the fourth quarter of 2026. John O'Neill, HSBC's managing director of digital assets and currencies, said the bank will "soon add more products, including expanding into wholesale corporate and institutional use cases."

value.detailed_summary_zh:
汇丰银行（HSBC）在其PayMe应用中推出港元稳定币RedCoin（代码RCHKD），该代币已获得香港金融管理局（HKMA）的发牌。超过330万用户可在未来数日内激活钱包，用于向朋友转账或在逾10万家PayMe商户付款。汇丰表示，计划在今年晚些时候将该代币接入其HSBC HK手机银行应用。

此次上线让一款获香港金管局发牌的稳定币直接进入大型全球银行现有的消费者钱包，香港用户无需开设加密货币交易所账户即可用基于区块链的货币付款，这使稳定币走出此前主要流通的交易平台场景。

RedCoin运行在汇丰自有的私有账本上，而非以太坊等公链，且余额无法在PayMe与汇丰银行应用之间转移；它也不是银行存款，不受香港存款保障计划覆盖。汇丰的储备追踪显示，上线不久后RedCoin流通量约1020万美元，由全部以现金形式持有的1040万美元作为支撑，首次独立储备 attestation（第三方审计确认）预计在2026年第四季度之后进行。汇丰数字资产与货币董事总经理John O'Neill表示，银行将“很快推出更多产品，包括拓展至批发企业及机构用例”。
value.market_impact_en: The rollout shifts stablecoin distribution toward a bank-operated consumer wallet with a captive user base, a channel that could pressure non-bank HKD-denominated issuers on the payments side, though the private-ledger design and closed-loop transferability limit interoperability with public-chain venues. With circulating supply near $10.2 million, the immediate liquidity effect on crypto trading markets is negligible.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次落地将稳定币的分发渠道转向拥有存量用户的银行消费钱包，这一渠道可能在支付领域对非银行的港元稳定币发行方形成压力；但私有账本设计及闭环式的可转移性限制了其与公链场所的互操作性。由于流通量仅约1020万美元，对加密交易市场的即时流动性影响微不足道。

value.detailed_summary:
On Oct. 22, India-based exchange CoinDCX again addressed on-chain controversy over deposit address TQKJQ, saying the address was compromised and deprecated after its July 2025 security incident and that users kept sending funds to it anyway. The exchange said its routine sweep process failed for a period, the failure was discovered that morning, and the resulting operational losses will be absorbed by CoinDCX, while all affected deposits were credited to users.

CoinDCX says affected users were fully credited and that funds remain in segregated cold wallets, with no loss of platform funds in active wallets — limiting direct user impact from an incident it otherwise describes as an operational failure.

The exchange said current centralized and user addresses are unaffected and that trading and platform operations continue as normal. It did not detail how roughly $15.8 million went unaccounted for over an extended period.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
10月22日，印度加密交易平台CoinDCX再次就存款地址TQKJQ的链上争议作出回应，称该地址在2025年7月安全事件后已被入侵并弃用，但仍有用户继续向其转入资金。平台表示其常规扫款流程在某一时段失效，问题于当日上午发现，由此产生的运营损失由CoinDCX自行承担，相关用户存款均已完成入账。

CoinDCX称受影响用户存款已全部入账，资金仍存放于隔离冷钱包，活跃钱包中的平台资金亦未被盗，从而将该事件对用户的直接冲击限制在平台自述的“运营失误”范围内。

平台称现行中心化地址与用户地址均未受影响，交易与平台运营照常进行。对于约1580万美元在较长时间内去向不明的原因，CoinDCX未作具体说明。
value.market_impact_en: The dispute keeps attention on exchange custody practices and deposit-address hygiene, a channel that can affect user confidence and deposit flows on Indian spot venues. CoinDCX's statement that active wallets and platform funds were untouched limits any immediate read-across to other exchanges, though unresolved questions about the unaccounted funds remain a sentiment risk for the platform.
value.market_impact_zh: 这场争议使市场持续关注交易所的托管流程与存款地址管理，这一渠道可能影响印度现货平台的用户信心与存款流入。CoinDCX称活跃钱包与平台资金未被盗，限制了事件向其他交易所的即时传导，但去向不明资金的相关疑问仍未解开，构成该平台的舆情风险。

value.background: The market for tokenized stocks has grown sharply over the past year: RWA.xyz data cited by the report puts distributed value at $3.58 billion, up from about $627 million a year earlier, a roughly 470% increase. Fragmentation and issuer pushback have accompanied that growth — OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange announced plans on Oct. 4 for a tokenized stock trading platform through their OKXICE joint venture, and 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs have since filed objections to having their shares traded there, without specifying reasons. In May, Tiger Research director Ryan Yoon warned that trading the same tokenized stocks across multiple blockchains could create price discrepancies, increase slippage and reduce market efficiency.
value.background_en: The market for tokenized stocks has grown sharply over the past year: RWA.xyz data cited by the report puts distributed value at $3.58 billion, up from about $627 million a year earlier, a roughly 470% increase. Fragmentation and issuer pushback have accompanied that growth — OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange announced plans on Oct. 4 for a tokenized stock trading platform through their OKXICE joint venture, and 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs have since filed objections to having their shares traded there, without specifying reasons. In May, Tiger Research director Ryan Yoon warned that trading the same tokenized stocks across multiple blockchains could create price discrepancies, increase slippage and reduce market efficiency.
value.background_zh: 过去一年，代币化股票市场大幅增长：报道援引 RWA.xyz 的数据称，其分布式价值已达 35.8 亿美元，高于一年前的约 6.27 亿美元，增幅约 470%。伴随增长的是市场碎片化和发行方的反对——OKX 与纽交所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）于 10 月 4 日宣布通过双方合资的 OKXICE 建设代币化股票交易平台，此后包括微软、Alphabet 和高盛在内的 16 家公司提交反对意见，但未说明理由。今年 5 月，Tiger Research 总监 Ryan Yoon 曾警告，同一代币化股票在多个区块链平台交易可能造成价格差异、 slippage 上升并降低市场效率。
value.detailed_summary:
Dune announced on Thursday that it has launched real-time market data feeds covering more than 200 onchain trading venues across 12 blockchains, including Ethereum, Solana, Base and XLayer, delivering trade data roughly one second after execution. The feeds cover spot trading on decentralized exchanges as well as perpetual futures on Hyperliquid and Lighter, with standardized data on prices, trade sizes and transaction details.

Dune co-founder and CEO Fredrik Haga said most institutions are watching onchain markets first because "they can't price these assets properly without them anymore," pointing to market data as the entry point for institutional onchain participation. The launch comes as tokenized stock markets expand and face growing scrutiny.

Haga said quant funds, market makers, asset managers and bank trading desks are among the first clients, but declined to identify them, citing nondisclosure agreements. According to Dune, these firms use the data to assess liquidity, compare prices across venues and evaluate trading strategies before committing capital.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Dune 于周四宣布推出实时市场数据源，覆盖以太坊、Solana、Base 和 XLayer 等 12 条区块链上的 200 多个链上交易场所，交易数据在成交后约一秒即可提供。该数据源覆盖去中心化交易所的现货交易，以及 Hyperliquid 和 Lighter 上的永续合约交易，并以标准化格式提供价格、成交规模和交易明细数据。

Dune 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Fredrik Haga 表示，多数机构首先关注链上市场，因为"没有这些数据，他们已经无法为这些资产正确定价"，意指市场数据是机构参与链上市场的入口。此次发布正值代币化股票市场快速扩张并面临日益严格审视之际。

Haga 表示，首批客户包括量化基金、做市商、资产管理机构和银行交易台，但以保密协议为由拒绝透露具体名称。据 Dune 介绍，这些机构使用该数据评估流动性、比较不同场所的价格，并在投入资金前评估交易策略。
value.market_impact_en: The feeds give institutional desks standardized, near-real-time pricing across DEX spot venues and perpetual futures platforms such as Hyperliquid and Lighter, lowering the data-integration barrier that currently sits between traditional trading systems and onchain execution. Over time that channel could affect liquidity and market-making depth on the covered venues, and it links tokenized-equity pricing debates to onchain market-data infrastructure.
value.market_impact_zh: 该数据源为机构交易台提供跨去中心化现货场所及 Hyperliquid、Lighter 等永续合约平台的标准化近实时价格，降低了目前横亘在传统交易系统与链上执行之间的数据接入门槛。这一渠道随时间可能影响被覆盖场所的流动性与做市深度，并将代币化股票的定价争议与链上市场数据基础设施联系起来。

value.background: The OCC is the primary federal regulator implementing stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act, the US stablecoin law that sets a 1:1 reserve standard of US dollars or short-term Treasuries for every token in circulation. The European Central Bank has separately warned that growing stablecoin adoption could shift deposits away from banks and affect lending and monetary policy.
value.background_en: The OCC is the primary federal regulator implementing stablecoin rules under the GENIUS Act, the US stablecoin law that sets a 1:1 reserve standard of US dollars or short-term Treasuries for every token in circulation. The European Central Bank has separately warned that growing stablecoin adoption could shift deposits away from banks and affect lending and monetary policy.
value.background_zh: OCC 是依据《GENIUS 法案》实施稳定币规则的主要联邦监管机构，该法要求发行方对每一枚流通中的代币持有 1:1 的美元或短期美国国债储备。欧洲央行也曾警告，稳定币采用度上升可能使存款从银行体系流出，并影响信贷投放与货币政策。
value.detailed_summary:
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has eased stablecoin reserve rules over objections from banks, which had sought safeguards against deposit flight. Banking groups warn the change could move billions of dollars of deposits out of traditional lending and into stablecoin reserves.

The rule determines what assets stablecoin issuers must hold against tokens in circulation, and bank groups argue looser standards make it easier for deposits to migrate from lending into reserve holdings.

The change was made without a prominent public rollout, and the reporting frames it as the removal of safeguards banks had requested against deposit flight.
value.detailed_summary_en:
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has eased stablecoin reserve rules over objections from banks, which had sought safeguards against deposit flight. Banking groups warn the change could move billions of dollars of deposits out of traditional lending and into stablecoin reserves.

The rule determines what assets stablecoin issuers must hold against tokens in circulation, and bank groups argue looser standards make it easier for deposits to migrate from lending into reserve holdings.

The change was made without a prominent public rollout, and the reporting frames it as the removal of safeguards banks had requested against deposit flight.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
美国货币监理署（OCC）在银行界的反对声中放宽了稳定币储备规则，银行此前一直寻求设置防止存款外流的保障条款。银行业警告称，这一调整可能使数千亿美元存款从传统放贷业务流入稳定币储备。

该规则决定了稳定币发行方必须以何种资产为其流通中的代币提供支撑，银行界认为更宽松的标准会使存款更容易从放贷流向储备资产。

这一调整并未高调公开推出，报道将其描述为取消了银行此前要求的防止存款外流的保障措施。
value.market_impact_en: The channel runs through reserve composition and bank funding: looser reserve standards can shift where stablecoin issuers park backing assets and pull deposits out of bank lending, affecting Treasury-bill demand in the reserve mix and stablecoin supply capacity. Exposure sits with stablecoin issuers, their custodian banks and the deposit franchises that fund credit.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于储备资产构成与银行资金来源：更宽松的储备标准会改变稳定币发行方停放担保资产的方式，并把存款从银行信贷体系中抽走，进而影响储备组合中的短期国债需求以及稳定币的供给能力。风险敞口主要落在稳定币发行方、其托管银行以及为信贷提供资金的存款业务上。

value.background: Binance first introduced bStocks in June with tokenized versions of companies including Nvidia, Tesla and Circle, and has continued adding supported securities since then, according to CoinInsider. value.background_zh: 据 CoinInsider 报道，币安最早于今年 6 月推出 bStocks，首批包含英伟达、特斯拉和 Circle 等公司的代币化版本，此后持续增加支持的证券。一份行业分析称，代币化股票交易在不到一年内从几乎为零增长到逾 200 亿欧元，且几乎全部以稳定币结算。监管机构也在澄清联邦证券法如何适用于代币化工具，美国 SEC 已就加密类证券发布指引。
value.detailed_summary:
Binance has launched bStocks, a tokenized securities product that gives users round-the-clock access to tokenized equity exposure on the exchange. The tokens trade on Binance's spot market rather than during traditional stock-market hours.

The product places continuous equity exposure on one of the largest crypto exchanges, extending trading past traditional market hours and creating an instrument that sits between crypto spot markets and regulated securities.

Binance's own documentation states that each bStocks token is backed 1:1 by a US share held at a regulated custodian and is traded 24/7 on the exchange's spot market. The offering is positioned with zero conversion fees and dividend-related features such as automatic reinvestment.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
币安推出名为 bStocks 的代币化证券产品，让用户可以在该交易所获得 7×24 小时的代币化股票敞口。这些代币在币安现货市场交易，而不受传统股票市场交易时段的限制。

该产品让全球最大加密交易所之一提供不间断的股票敞口，把交易时间延伸到传统市场时段之外，并形成一种介于加密现货市场与受监管证券之间的工具。

币安自有资料称，每个 bStocks 代币由存放于受监管托管机构的美国股票 1:1 支撑，并在其现货市场 7×24 小时交易。该产品以零转换费以及自动再投资等股息相关功能作为卖点。
value.market_impact_en: bStocks routes equity exposure through Binance's spot venue and stablecoin settlement, putting the exchange in competition with other onchain equity platforms and with brokers' extended-hours offerings. Expansion of this segment can shift stablecoin and trading-volume flows toward venues listing tokenized equities, while custody arrangements and securities-law treatment remain the binding constraints.

value.detailed_summary:
Bitcoin Lightning developers are warning publicly about security flaws after a second patch was released within five days, CryptoSlate reported. No confirmed large-scale exploit or systemic loss event has been reported in the available material.

The warning puts Lightning node operators on notice to apply the latest fixes, since security defects in payment-channel software are an operational risk for systems that hold and route funds.

The second patch arrived within a five-day window, underscoring that fixes are being rolled out in quick succession. The available evidence does not establish that the flaws were exploited at scale.

value.background: Redeemable debt carries a fixed maturity date on which the issuer must repay the principal to holders. GPU-backed lending and project-level debt for AI data centers have grown into a distinct financing channel as AI compute build-outs scale, with lenders focusing on hardware commitments, delivery timing and counterparty credit quality. An investment-grade rating generally broadens access to such credit by signaling a relatively lower assessed default risk.

value.background_zh: 可赎回债务设有固定到期日，发行方须在该日期向持有人偿还本金。随着 AI 算力建设规模扩大，以 GPU 为抵押的贷款以及面向 AI 数据中心的项目级债务已发展为独立的融资渠道，贷款方关注硬件采购承诺、交付时点和交易对手的信用质量。投资级评级通常意味着被评估的违约风险相对较低，从而拓宽此类信贷的可获得性。
value.detailed_summary:
Elon Musk said SpaceX has completed $40 billion of redeemable GPU debt financing, with the proceeds mainly earmarked for GPUs scheduled to arrive in the first and second quarters. According to BlockBeats, Musk credited the company's investment-grade credit rating and revenue from its Starlink satellite-internet and launch businesses with keeping its access to credit open.

As described, the package would be among the largest disclosed debt raises aimed specifically at buying AI compute, indicating that GPU purchases are being funded through credit markets rather than only from operating cash flow. Musk said the spending will have little impact on the current quarter because the hardware has not yet arrived.

Musk described the instrument as redeemable debt — borrowing with a defined repayment date — but the flash report did not disclose lenders, coupon, maturity or other terms, and there was no independent confirmation of the financing. BlockBeats listed the borrower under the ticker SPCX.O, although SpaceX is not a publicly listed company.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
马斯克表示，SpaceX 已完成 400 亿美元的可赎回 GPU 债务融资，资金主要用于购买将于第一季度和第二季度到货的 GPU。据 BlockBeats 报道，马斯克称公司的投资级信用评级，以及来自 Starlink 卫星互联网和发射业务的收入，有助于其维持信贷渠道畅通。

按目前披露的说法，这将是专门用于采购 AI 算力的规模最大的债务融资之一，说明 GPU 采购正通过信贷市场而非仅靠经营现金流来支撑。马斯克表示，由于硬件尚未到货，这笔支出对本季度影响不大。

马斯克将该工具称为可赎回债务，即设有既定偿还日期的借款；但该快讯未披露贷款方、票息、期限等条款，也没有独立消息证实这笔融资。BlockBeats 在快讯中以 SPCX.O 代码指代该借款主体，而 SpaceX 并非上市公司。

value.background_zh: Anthropic 已于 6 月 1 日向 SEC 秘密提交注册声明草案。SEC 的指引明确，秘密提交并不能满足“路演前至少 15 天公开申报”的要求，因此若要在 11 月 9 日当周启动路演，就须在 10 月下旬完成公开申报。彭博此前报道称，该 IPO 可能在 11 月感恩节前完成。
value.detailed_summary:
Anthropic plans to launch its IPO in mid-November at a target valuation of up to $2 trillion, but a recent selloff in AI-related stocks and a narrowing listing window have made the timetable uncertain, BlockBeats reported on Oct. 24. Under SEC rules a company must publicly file its S-1 at least 15 days before starting its roadshow, meaning Anthropic would need to file by next week to complete a listing in late November.

The filing deadline makes the next week a decisive checkpoint: missing it would push a record-sized AI listing past its targeted window. Prediction markets currently put roughly 80% odds on Anthropic listing before the end of the year.

The report cites CoreWeave shares falling about 30% in two weeks and Micron down about 17% over the past month, reflecting rising concern about the sustainability of AI capital spending and financing capacity. Some market participants expect Anthropic to postpone the listing for a better environment, while analysts argue its pressing need for compute funding and a potentially harder private fundraising market may push it to proceed.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
BlockBeats 10 月 24 日报道，Anthropic 计划于 11 月中旬启动 IPO，目标估值高达 2 万亿美元，但 AI 板块近期遭遇抛售、上市时间窗口收窄，使其计划面临不确定性。按美国证券交易委员会（SEC）规定，公司须在启动路演前至少 15 天公开提交 S-1 招股文件，若要赶在 11 月下旬完成上市，Anthropic 最晚需于下周提交文件。

这一申报截止期使下周成为关键节点：一旦错过，这宗创纪录规模的 AI 上市将滑出既定窗口。预测市场目前给出 Anthropic 年内上市约 80% 的概率。

报道称，CoreWeave 股价两周内下跌约 30%，美光过去一个月下跌约 17%，反映市场对 AI 资本开支可持续性及融资能力的担忧升温。部分市场人士认为 Anthropic 可能推迟上市以等待更有利的市场环境；但也有分析师指出，公司对算力投资资金的需求迫切，私募融资可能趋难，或将推动其继续推进 IPO。
value.market_impact_en: The IPO timetable works as a sentiment gauge for AI-linked risk assets: a delay would signal weaker appetite for large AI equity issuance, a channel that can feed through risk appetite and liquidity expectations into AI-themed crypto tokens and broader digital-asset positioning. CoreWeave's and Micron's declines show the same AI-capex financing concern already priced in adjacent listed markets.
value.market_impact_zh: IPO 时间表充当 AI 相关风险资产的情绪风向标：若延期，将释放大型 AI 股权发行需求转弱的信号，并通过风险偏好与流动性预期传导至 AI 概念加密代币及更广泛的数字资产仓位。CoreWeave 与美光的下跌显示，同一条围绕 AI 资本开支融资的担忧已在相关上市市场中定价。

value.background: The case is the latest in a series of federal-versus-state disputes over prediction markets. In September, New Jersey officials petitioned the US Supreme Court to weigh in on their case against Kalshi, alongside pending lawsuits in Michigan, Ohio, Kentucky, Nevada, Massachusetts, Wisconsin and New York; as of Tuesday the court had not said whether it will hear arguments. CFTC Chair Michael Selig has argued for months that the regulator holds exclusive jurisdiction over prediction markets, and the National Conference of State Legislatures counted more than 20 lawsuits and cease-and-desist actions pending nationwide as of early 2026.

value.background_zh: 这起案件是联邦与州政府围绕预测市场的一系列争端中的最新一例。去年9月，新泽西州官员请求美国最高法院受理其针对Kalshi的案件；密歇根、俄亥俄、肯塔基、内华达、马萨诸塞、威斯康星和纽约也有类似诉讼待决。截至周二，最高法院尚未宣布是否会听取辩论。CFTC主席迈克尔·塞利格（Michael Selig）数月来一直主张该机构对预测市场拥有专属管辖权；全美州议会联合会（NCSL）统计，截至2026年初，全国已有20多起诉讼和停止令待决。
value.detailed_summary:
The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed suit in the US District Court for the District of Utah against the State of Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown, seeking to block state enforcement against prediction-market operators. The Monday filing came a week after Utah announced legal action against Kalshi and its affiliates to recover up to $60 million in profits it alleges were obtained illegally.

The suit directly contests whether a state may apply its gambling laws to platforms the CFTC has authorized, and a Kalshi spokesperson, Jacki McGavick, said no single state should have a veto over a national derivatives market overseen by the CFTC. The CFTC argues that Utah's action intrudes on what it calls Congress's exclusive federal scheme for commodity derivatives.

The CFTC's complaint states that the event contracts targeted by Utah are "swaps" under the Commodity Exchange Act and that the exchanges offering them are CFTC-regulated Designated Contract Markets. It argues Utah's efforts to stop a CFTC-regulated DCM from offering CFTC-approved products bypass congressional intent to federally preempt state law.
value.detailed_summary_en:

The suit directly contests whether a state may apply its gambling laws to platforms the CFTC has authorized, and a Kalshi spokesperson, Jacki McGavick, said no single state should have a veto over a national derivatives market overseen by the CFTC. The CFTC argues that Utah's action intrudes on what it calls Congress's exclusive federal scheme for commodity derivatives.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）向美国犹他州联邦地区法院提起诉讼，起诉犹他州及该州总检察长德里克·布朗（Derek Brown），试图阻止该州对预测市场运营方展开执法。该诉讼于周一提交，而一周前犹他州刚宣布对Kalshi及其关联公司采取法律行动，要求追回其声称非法获得的至多6000万美元利润。

这起诉讼直接争讼各州能否对CFTC已批准的平台上适用本州博彩法。Kalshi发言人杰基·麦加维克（Jacki McGavick）表示，不应由任何单一州对受CFTC监管的全国性衍生品市场拥有否决权。CFTC则主张，犹他州的行动侵犯了国会为商品衍生品市场设计的专属联邦监管体系。

CFTC在诉状中称，犹他州所针对的事件合约属于《商品交易法》下的“互换”（swaps），提供这些合约的交易所是受CFTC监管的指定合约市场（DCM）。该机构主张，犹他州试图阻止受CFTC监管的指定合约市场提供经CFTC批准的产品，绕过了国会以联邦法优先于州法的立法意图。
value.market_impact_en: The outcome shapes where CFTC-registered event-contract venues such as Kalshi can operate, since state gambling enforcement or preemption determines platform access in individual states by market. A federal win would remove a state-level legal channel for restricting those venues; a state win would open the door to profit-recovery claims and operating restrictions.
value.market_impact_zh: 该案结果将决定Kalshi等CFTC注册事件合约平台可在哪些地区运营，因为州层面的博彩执法或联邦优先适用直接决定各州的市场准入。若联邦一方胜诉，各州限制此类平台的法律途径将被削弱；若州一方胜诉，则可能引发追缴利润的索赔和运营限制。

value.background: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet in January 2025, introducing hooks, the singleton contract design and flash accounting. Hooks let developers attach custom logic to pools, and Aggregator Hooks is the first use of that mechanism to route into other protocols' liquidity rather than only Uniswap's own pools.
value.background_en: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet in January 2025, introducing hooks, the singleton contract design and flash accounting. Hooks let developers attach custom logic to pools, and Aggregator Hooks is the first use of that mechanism to route into other protocols' liquidity rather than only Uniswap's own pools.
value.background_zh: Uniswap v4 于 2025 年 1 月上线主网，引入 Hook、单例合约设计与闪 accounting（闪电记账）机制。Hook 允许开发者给资金池附加自定义逻辑，而 Aggregator Hooks 是首次用该机制将路由接入其他协议的流动性，而不仅是 Uniswap 自身资金池。
value.detailed_summary:
Uniswap Labs said in an Oct. 22 post that Aggregator Hooks are now live, making Uniswap v4 function as an aggregator by wrapping external liquidity sources into v4 pools that any router can treat as a Uniswap pool. The feature is available in the Uniswap Web app and API on Ethereum mainnet, Base and Robinhood Chain, with more chains to follow and seven liquidity sources at launch, including Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap.

Uniswap said most onchain liquidity already sits on Uniswap but new liquidity can still emerge elsewhere, so folding external venues into v4 puts it in more direct competition with standalone DEX aggregators. Swaps routed through those external sources pay the protocol fee and contribute to UNI burn, linking aggregator volume to UNI supply.

Per block, the router pulls the latest quotes from integrated sources, builds the best path between Uniswap pools and external venues, and settles within a single transaction without requiring new approvals. BlockBeats reported the launch on Oct. 22.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Uniswap Labs 于 10 月 22 日发文称，Aggregator Hooks 现已上线，Uniswap v4 由此具备聚合功能：该机制通过 Hook 将外部流动性来源包装成 v4 池，任何路由均可将其视为 Uniswap 池。该功能已在以太坊主网、Base 与 Robinhood Chain 的 Uniswap 网页端与 API 上线，更多网络将陆续接入；上线首日支持七个外部来源，包括 Curve、Fluid 与 PancakeSwap。

Uniswap 表示，大部分链上流动性已在 Uniswap，但新流动性仍可能出现在其他场所；把外部来源纳入 v4 后，Uniswap 与独立 DEX 聚合器的竞争更为直接。经外部来源路由的兑换将缴纳协议费，并贡献于 UNI 销毁，从而把聚合交易量与 UNI 供应连接起来。

每区块路由会从已接入来源拉取最新报价，在 Uniswap 池与外部来源之间构建最优路径，并在单笔交易内完成结算，无需新增授权。BlockBeats 于 10 月 22 日报道了此次上线。
value.market_impact_en: The release touches the DEX aggregator segment directly: Uniswap v4 can now absorb quotes from venues such as Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap through its own router, so aggregator order flow and fee capture shift toward Uniswap's Web app and API. For UNI, the transmission channel is the protocol fee on externally routed swaps feeding the burn, making token supply sensitive to aggregator volume rather than only to Uniswap-native pool activity.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次发布直接作用于 DEX 聚合器这一细分市场：Uniswap v4 现在可以通过自身路由吸收 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等场所的报价，聚合器订单流与手续费捕获由此向 Uniswap 网页端与 API 转移。对 UNI 而言，传导渠道是经外部来源路由的兑换所缴纳的协议费进入销毁，使代币供应不仅取决于 Uniswap 原生池活动，也对聚合交易量敏感。

value.background_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿运营 BENJI 这一自有的区块链集成登记系统，可在公链基础设施上支持代币化共同基金份额，并通过 Benji Investments 应用提供热钱包与冷钱包环境。BENJI 最初在 Stellar 上线，2026 年 4 月该公司与 Stellar 发展基金会共同纪念该产品推出五周年。另有一项安排中，星展银行（DBS）与富兰克林邓普顿宣布在 DBS Digital Exchange 上使用 Ripple 的 RLUSD 稳定币进行 sgBENJI 的交易与借贷方案，星展银行还将探索允许 sgBENJI 作为抵押品。
value.detailed_summary:
Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million of tokenized money-market fund shares to the XRP Ledger, lifting the network's sgBENJI supply from about 48 million to 193 million tokens, according to CoinDesk. Priced at $1.039 per share in the transaction records, the total is worth about $200 million and is held in a single wallet.

The move nearly quadruples the fund's footprint on XRP Ledger, extending a large U.S. asset manager's tokenized money-market product onto a public chain beyond its original Stellar base.

The tokens are all concentrated in one wallet, a holding pattern the reports note without attributing it to a specific custodian or client. Franklin Templeton's BENJI was the first U.S.-registered money market fund to use a public blockchain as its system of record, and sgBENJI is tracked as a tokenized fund asset by RWA.xyz.
