value.detailed_summary_zh:
据 CoinDesk 报道，富兰克林邓普顿（Franklin Templeton）向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元的代币化货币市场基金份额，使该网络上的 sgBENJI 代币总量从约 4800 万枚增至 1.93 亿枚。按交易记录中每份 1.039 美元计算，总价值约 2 亿美元，且全部存放于单一钱包。

此举使该基金在 XRP Ledger 上的规模接近原来的四倍，意味着这家美国大型资产管理公司将代币化货币市场基金产品从最初的 Stellar 网络扩展到更多公链。

这些代币全部集中于单一钱包，报道提及了这一持仓结构，但未说明对应的托管方或具体客户。富兰克林邓普顿的 BENJI 是首只以公链作为登记系统的美国注册货币市场基金，sgBENJI 也被 RWA.xyz 作为代币化基金资产进行追踪。
value.market_impact_en: The addition expands the tokenized Treasury/money-market segment on XRP Ledger, where the size of on-chain RWA supply is a key input for stablecoin and lending activity; sgBENJI's integration with RLUSD on DBS Digital Exchange and planned collateral use give the token a potential role in XRPL-based liquidity and credit, though the single-wallet concentration limits any immediate circulation effect.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次增发扩大了 XRP Ledger 上的代币化国债/货币市场基金板块，而链上 RWA 规模是衡量该网络稳定币与借贷活跃度的重要变量；sgBENJI 在 DBS Digital Exchange 上已与 RLUSD 打通，并计划用于抵押，使其可能在 XRPL 的流动性与信贷场景中发挥作用，不过全部集中于单一钱包也意味着短期内流通层面的影响有限。

value.background_zh: CoinDCX 是一家以印度市场为主的交易所，自称拥有超过 1400 万用户，并表示其上币种类在印度平台中属于最多之列。印度交易所此前已多次遭遇安全事件，其中 WazirX 在 2024 年 7 月披露入侵事件后暂停了加密货币交易。Coinbase 通过受爱尔兰监管的实体在欧洲开展业务，因此爱尔兰央行是其欧盟业务的重要监管机构。
value.detailed_summary:
Indian crypto exchange CoinDCX has acknowledged a new security breach, confirming the incident only after the fact rather than at the time it occurred. Separately, Ireland's central bank issued another penalty against Coinbase's Irish entity, with reports citing a €3.25 million ($3.6 million) fine over safeguarding and outsourcing obligations.

The two disclosures land on the same exchange-risk themes — custody security and regulatory compliance — that supervisors have been tightening. Ireland's central bank framed the Coinbase action as customer protection, stating: "This action against Coinbase Ireland underlines the Central Bank's focus on ensuring that customers are at all times protected and that the integrity of the financial system is maintained."

The Coinbase penalty reported in the safeguarding and outsourcing case requires approval from Ireland's High Court before taking effect. Delano separately reported a €21.5 million penalty against Coinbase Europe for anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing failures, described as Ireland's first enforcement action in the crypto sector.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
印度加密货币交易所 CoinDCX 承认发生了一起新的安全入侵事件，但披露时间明显滞后于事件本身。与此同时，爱尔兰央行再次对 Coinbase 的爱尔兰实体开出罚单，相关报道称罚款金额为 325 万欧元（约 360 万美元），事由涉及客户资产保障与外包义务方面的违规。

这两则消息同时指向交易所风险的两大核心议题——托管安全与合规监管，而监管机构正持续收紧这两方面的要求。爱尔兰央行将针对 Coinbase 的执法行动定性为客户保护，并表示：“此次对 Coinbase Ireland 的行动凸显了央行确保客户始终受到保护、并维护金融体系完整性的关注。”

在客户资产保障与外包一案中，针对 Coinbase 的处罚需经爱尔兰高等法院批准后方可生效。Delano 另行报道称，Coinbase Europe 因反洗钱与反恐融资方面的缺失被处以 2150 万欧元罚款，并称这是爱尔兰在加密行业采取的首次执法行动。

value.background: Initia is a blockchain network that lets developers choose among EVM, MoveVM and WasmVM within a single interoperable system; MoveVM is the virtual machine built for the Move language. LayerZero is a cross-chain messaging protocol used for asset movement between chains, while Noble and Circle's CCTP are rails for transferring USDC across networks. Initia said the security fix is expected to be completed and audited within a few days, and that a full post-mortem report will follow.
value.background_en: Initia is a blockchain network that lets developers choose among EVM, MoveVM and WasmVM within a single interoperable system; MoveVM is the virtual machine built for the Move language. LayerZero is a cross-chain messaging protocol used for asset movement between chains, while Noble and Circle's CCTP are rails for transferring USDC across networks. Initia said the security fix is expected to be completed and audited within a few days, and that a full post-mortem report will follow.
value.background_zh: Initia 是一个允许开发者在同一互操作网络中选择 EVM、MoveVM 和 WasmVM 的区块链平台，MoveVM 是为 Move 语言构建的虚拟机。LayerZero 是用于跨链资产流转的消息协议，Noble 与 Circle 的 CCTP 则是跨网络转移 USDC 的通道。Initia 称安全修复预计将在数天内完成并通过审计，后续将发布完整事后复盘报告。
value.detailed_summary:
Initia said in a post on X that an attacker exploited a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability at 22:59 on October 23 to bypass security checks and forge MoveVM state, crediting itself with WETH, iUSD and USDC that had no actual backing. Roughly $2.7 million in assets had already been moved out before the network was paused.

The incident prompted Initia to pause its L1 and Rollups, halting activity across the ecosystem while the fix is completed and audited; asset recovery work is ongoing with security partners.

Initia said the total supply of the affected tokens did not change and that INIT was not minted, so its total supply is unaffected. The funds moved were 105 WETH and about 1.4 million AUSD0 via LayerZero, plus about 1.08 million USDC via Noble and CCTP, later swapped into 1,135.52 ETH now held at Ethereum address 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Initia said in a post on X that an attacker exploited a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability at 22:59 on October 23 to bypass security checks and forge MoveVM state, crediting itself with WETH, iUSD and USDC that had no actual backing. Roughly $2.7 million in assets had already been moved out before the network was paused.

The incident prompted Initia to pause its L1 and Rollups, halting activity across the ecosystem while the fix is completed and audited; asset recovery work is ongoing with security partners.

Initia said the total supply of the affected tokens did not change and that INIT was not minted, so its total supply is unaffected. The funds moved were 105 WETH and about 1.4 million AUSD0 via LayerZero, plus about 1.08 million USDC via Noble and CCTP, later swapped into 1,135.52 ETH now held at Ethereum address 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Initia 在 X 平台发帖称，攻击者于 10 月 23 日 22:59 利用 Initia MoveVM 脚本缓存（script caching）漏洞绕过安全检查、伪造 MoveVM 状态，为自己记入无实际支撑的 WETH、iUSD 和 USDC。在网络暂停前，攻击者已转出约 270 万美元资产。

该事件导致 Initia 暂停 L1 及 Rollup，生态内活动随之停摆，修复方案尚待完成并通过审计；资产追回工作正与安全合作伙伴推进。

Initia 表示相关代币总供应量未发生变化，INIT 未被增发，总供应量不受影响。转出的资产包括通过 LayerZero 转出的 105 枚 WETH 和约 140 万枚 AUSD0，以及通过 Noble 和 CCTP 转出的约 108 万枚 USDC，随后兑换为 1135.52 枚 ETH，现存放于以太坊地址 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8。
value.market_impact_en: The stolen assets left Initia through LayerZero, Noble and CCTP and were consolidated into 1,135.52 ETH on Ethereum, linking the loss to ETH liquidity and to the cross-chain messaging and USDC transfer rails involved. Although INIT's supply is unaffected, the continued L1 and Rollup pause halts on-chain activity and asset movement within the Initia ecosystem.
value.market_impact_zh: 被盗资产经由 LayerZero、Noble 和 CCTP 转出 Initia，并在以太坊上归集为 1135.52 枚 ETH，使损失与 ETH 流动性以及相关跨链消息和 USDC 转账通道产生关联。尽管 INIT 供应量未受影响，L1 及 Rollup 仍处暂停状态，Initia 生态内的链上活动与资产流转随之中断。

value.background: The GENIUS Act is the federal statute establishing a framework for payment stablecoins, and the OCC is the primary banking regulator tasked with implementing it for issuers under its oversight. The rule applies to national banks, federal savings associations, federal branches and their subsidiaries, nonbank firms that seek or receive federal qualified issuer status, foreign payment stablecoin issuers, and state-qualified issuers where the OCC has regulatory or enforcement authority. Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould described the framework as providing "strong standards for reserve backing, redemption, and risk management." Anti-money-laundering, Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions requirements are being handled in a separate rulemaking with Treasury.

value.background_zh: 《GENIUS 法案》是确立支付型稳定币监管框架的联邦立法，OCC 是负责为其监管下的发行方落实该法案的主要银行监管机构。该规则适用于国民银行、联邦储蓄协会、联邦分行及其子公司、申请或获得联邦合格发行方资格的非银行机构、外国支付型稳定币发行方，以及在 OCC 拥有监管或执法权的情况下的州级合格发行方。货币监理署署长乔纳森·古尔德称该框架提供了"储备支持、赎回和风险管理方面的严格标准"。反洗钱、银行保密法及制裁相关要求则由 OCC 与财政部通过另一项规则制定程序处理。
value.detailed_summary:
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency finalized its first rule implementing the GENIUS Act on Wednesday, covering payment stablecoin issuance, custody and third-party partnerships for entities under its jurisdiction, with the rule and the statute taking effect January 18, 2027. Existing stablecoin yield and rewards programs receive no automatic grandfathering or safe harbor and will be assessed for compliance case by case.

Because reward and yield programs are a material revenue line for major exchanges and issuers such as Coinbase, PayPal and Kraken, the refusal to grandfather existing programs means those products face individual compliance review rather than continuing automatically once the framework takes effect.

The final rule requires issuers to hold reserves worth at least as much as their outstanding stablecoins and generally to process redemption requests within two business days. The OCC dropped a proposed presumption that certain arrangements involving affiliates or related third parties violate the yield ban, while retaining the prohibition on issuers paying interest or yield solely for holding, using or retaining stablecoins, and said it will announce separately when it begins processing issuer applications and waiver requests.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
美国货币监理署（OCC）周三敲定了首份落实《GENIUS 法案》的最终规则，覆盖其管辖范围内实体的支付型稳定币发行、托管及第三方合作安排，该规则与法案均将于 2027 年 1 月 18 日生效。现有稳定币收益与奖励计划不会自动获得祖父条款或安全港待遇，需逐案接受合规评估。

由于奖励与收益计划是 Coinbase、PayPal、Kraken 等主要交易所和发行方的重要收入来源，拒绝给予现有计划祖父条款意味着这些产品需逐一接受合规审查，而不能在框架生效后自动延续。

最终规则要求发行方持有的储备价值至少与其未偿稳定币规模相当，并通常在两个工作日内处理赎回请求。OCC 删除了此前提出的一项推定，即涉及关联方或相关第三方的某些安排违反收益禁令；同时保留了禁止发行方仅因持有、使用或留存稳定币而支付利息或收益的规定，并表示将另行宣布何时开始受理发行方申请与豁免请求。
value.market_impact_en: The rule transmits to crypto markets through the revenue models of stablecoin issuers and the exchanges that distribute their tokens: without a safe harbor, rewards programs tied to holding stablecoins face case-by-case regulatory review, creating product-structure uncertainty for issuers and platforms that market such incentives. Reserve, redemption and custody standards also set compliance costs for entities seeking OCC-supervised issuer status.
value.market_impact_zh: 该规则通过稳定币发行方及分销其代币的交易所的收入模式传导至加密市场：在没有安全港的情况下，与持有稳定币挂钩的奖励计划需逐案接受监管审查，给发行方和推广此类激励的平台带来产品结构上的不确定性。储备、赎回与托管标准也为寻求 OCC 监管下发行方资格的机构设定了合规成本。

value.detailed_summary:
Brazil’s equity market lost more than $200 billion in value at Monday’s open after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in Sunday’s runoff, 51.79% to 48.21%. The iShares MSCI Brazil ETF (EWZ) fell as much as 26% from Friday’s close of about $42.60 to $31.40, the dollar rose as much as 12% against the real, and São Paulo exchange B3 halted trading for 30 minutes — its first circuit breaker since the COVID-19 pandemic.

The result contradicted prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi, which had put Bolsonaro near 80% the day before the vote, and Bolsonaro said Sunday night that he does not recognize the outcome and will ask the courts to annul the election, extending political uncertainty beyond the market open.

The Ibovespa fell as much as 17% to about 170,000 points before the 10% drop trigger paused trading, and kept sliding after the 30-minute halt; for a dollar-based investor the currency and index moves combined to a loss of about 26% at their worst. Lula’s margin was about 4.4 million votes, according to Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court, while the latest Datafolha poll had the race tied at 50% each among valid votes.

value.background: Drift, a Solana-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange, reported losses from the April 1 exploit, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group. On Oct. 1 the protocol opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds. value.background_zh: Drift 是一家基于 Solana 的去中心化永续合约交易所，其 4 月 1 日遭到的攻击造成损失，安全顾问 Mandiant 将此次攻击归因于一个朝鲜威胁组织。10 月 1 日，该协议开放了 DFX 恢复代币的申领与赎回，使受损用户对一个初始规模约 310 万美元、并获得交易所收入和追回资金的资金池拥有求偿权。Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币器，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机的网络，用于模糊资金来源与目的地地址之间的关联。
value.detailed_summary:
Wallets tied to the April Drift Protocol exploit deposited another 24,885 ETH (about $61.3 million) into Tornado Cash within roughly one hour, according to on-chain monitor Ember (余烬), bringing the attacker's two-day total to 50,595 ETH (about $122 million). The exploiter-linked addresses still held 56,569 ETH, worth roughly $139 million, after the transfers.

The funds are now passing through a mixer designed to break the on-chain link between deposit and withdrawal addresses, making tracing harder for investigators and reducing the likelihood that affected Drift users recover the stolen assets.

The reported loss figures vary by source: the headline cites over $270 million, while reporting on the April 1 hack puts losses at about $295 million, which DefiLlama ranks as the year's third-largest crypto heist. Some trackers recorded a two-day total of 44,510 ETH (about $109 million), including 18,800 ETH (about $46 million) transferred on Wednesday, a figure that differs from the 50,595 ETH cited by Ember.

据链上监测账号余烬统计，与 4 月 Drift Protocol 攻击事件相关的钱包在约一小时内再向 Tornado Cash 存入 24,885 枚 ETH（约 6104 万美元），使该攻击者两日累计存入量达到 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元）。转账后，被标记为攻击者的地址仍持有 56,569 枚 ETH，价值约 1.39 亿美元。

value.background: The local smoothing conjecture was proposed by Christopher Sogge in 1991 and sits at the top of a chain of harmonic-analysis conjectures: it implies the Bochner–Riesz conjecture, which implies the restriction conjecture, which implies the Kakeya conjecture. The Exponential Time Hypothesis posits that 3-SAT cannot be solved in sub-exponential time and is widely used to derive hardness results, including in parameterized complexity. Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000.
value.background_en: The local smoothing conjecture was proposed by Christopher Sogge in 1991 and sits at the top of a chain of harmonic-analysis conjectures: it implies the Bochner–Riesz conjecture, which implies the restriction conjecture, which implies the Kakeya conjecture. The Exponential Time Hypothesis posits that 3-SAT cannot be solved in sub-exponential time and is widely used to derive hardness results, including in parameterized complexity. Yang–Mills existence and mass gap is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems set by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000.
value.background_zh: 局部光滑猜想由 Christopher Sogge 于1991年提出，位于调和分析一系列猜想的最上端：它蕴含 Bochner–Riesz 猜想，后者蕴含限制性猜想，再蕴含 Kakeya 猜想。指数时间假设认为 3-SAT 无法在亚指数时间内求解，被广泛用于推导困难性结果，包括参数化复杂性领域。Yang–Mills 存在性与质量间隙是克莱数学研究所于2000年设立的七个千禧年大奖难题之一。

value.detailed_summary:
OpenAI announced on October 26, 2026 that its models produced natural-language proofs of three long-standing open results: local smoothing for the Kakeya conjecture, the falsity of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), and the existence of quantum chromodynamics and completions of the Standard Model. The Yang–Mills existence proof was generated on September 9, 2026 and the QCD proof on September 18, 2026, with the release held back until Lean formalization of the Yang–Mills result was completed on October 16, 2026.

OpenAI framed the release around how researchers can verify and build on the results, and said the volume and complexity of the work was why publication waited on Lean formalization. Commenters with complexity-theory background treated an ETH refutation as the most consequential item, since ETH underpins many hardness and lower-bound results.

The local smoothing claim is presented as settling Kakeya and Stein's restriction conjecture in every dimension, a problem open since 1991. No independent verification of the proofs has been reported; coverage at the time of the announcement described the results as still unverified.
value.detailed_summary_en:

The Yang–Mills existence proof was generated on September 9, 2026 and the QCD proof on September 18, 2026, with the release held back until Lean formalization of the Yang–Mills result was completed on October 16, 2026.

OpenAI framed the release around how researchers can verify and build on the results, and said the volume and complexity of the work was why publication waited on Lean formalization. Commenters with complexity-theory background treated an ETH refutation as the most consequential item, since ETH underpins many hardness and lower-bound results.

The local smoothing claim is presented as settling Kakeya and Stein's restriction conjecture in every dimension, a problem open since 1991. No independent verification of the proofs has been reported; coverage at the time of the announcement described the results as still unverified.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
2026年10月26日，OpenAI 宣布其模型给出了三项长期悬而未决结果的自然语言证明：Kakeya 猜想相关的局部光滑（local smoothing）、指数时间假设（ETH）为假，以及量子色动力学与标准模型完备化的存在性。其中 Yang–Mills 存在性证明生成于2026年9月9日，QCD 证明生成于9月18日，发布被推迟至10月16日 Yang–Mills 结果的 Lean 形式化完成后才进行。

OpenAI 将此次发布定位为研究者如何验证并在此基础上继续推进，并称正因工作量庞大且复杂，才等到 Lean 形式化完成后才公布。具备复杂性理论背景的评论者认为，ETH 被推翻是其中影响最大的一项，因为 ETH 是许多困难性与下界结果的基石。

局部光滑方面的主张被认为一并解决了任意维度的 Kakeya 猜想与 Stein 限制性猜想，该问题自1991年起悬而未决。目前尚无对这些证明的独立验证报道；发布当日的报道称相关结果仍未经核实。

value.background_zh: Kalshi 是一家总部位于纽约、受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的预测市场，以二元事件合约闻名。该公司此前依赖 LedgerX 进行清算，目前正将清算业务转入自有的 Kalshi Klear 清算所，并将其描述为「技术优先」的衍生品清算机构。通胀敞口传统上通过通胀互换和通胀挂钩债券进行交易，而非交易所上市的 CPI 期货。
value.detailed_summary:
Kalshi is pitching large global banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, according to Bloomberg, and has hired former Barclays trader Michael Ashton to design the contracts and bring in institutional investors. A Kalshi spokesperson confirmed the company is developing CPI futures but did not disclose launch details.

According to the report, the product would be the only futures contract currently tied directly to CPI, after CME Group stopped offering its own CPI futures.

Per pitch documents seen by Bloomberg, the futures would cover the next 12 reference months, followed by May and November contracts for the following four years, trade 24 hours a day from Sunday to Friday, and be cleared by Kalshi Klear. Ashton, hired to design the contracts, is known for his inflation trading expertise and has been dubbed "Mr. Inflation."

据彭博社报道，Kalshi 正向全球大型银行和对冲基金推介于 12 月推出追踪美国消费者价格指数（CPI）及核心通胀指标的交易所交易期货合约，并已聘请巴克莱前交易员 Michael Ashton 负责设计合约并吸引大型投资机构参与。Kalshi 发言人证实正在开发 CPI 期货，但未透露推出细节。

value.background: Blast announced on October 2 that it would gradually shut down the Layer 2 network, citing operating costs that exceeded revenue and the absence of a credible path to economic sustainability. Blast was an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack that offered built-in yield on deposited assets.
value.background_en: Blast announced on October 2 that it would gradually shut down the Layer 2 network, citing operating costs that exceeded revenue and the absence of a credible path to economic sustainability. Blast was an Ethereum Layer 2 built on the OP Stack that offered built-in yield on deposited assets.
value.background_zh: Blast 于 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关闭该 Layer 2 网络，理由是运营成本超过收入，且缺乏实现经济可持续发展的可信路径。Blast 是基于 OP Stack 构建的以太坊 Layer 2，主打为存入资产提供内置收益。
value.detailed_summary:
Blast reached the deadline for its standard withdrawal interface on October 26, with roughly $40.41 million in assets still sitting in its official Ethereum mainnet bridge. That figure is down about 36% from approximately $63.5 million on October 2, when the Layer 2 network announced it would wind down.

After October 26, holders can still withdraw, but only by interacting directly with the bridge contracts on Ethereum rather than through the regular website interface, per Blast's prior notice.

Blast has published contract-level withdrawal guides for ETH, USDB and BLAST; the reported process involves initiating a withdrawal on Blast, waiting for the corresponding state record to be posted to Ethereum, submitting a withdrawal proof through the OptimismPortal contract, then a challenge period and a final confirmation transaction. At the time of the report, Blast's website still displayed a withdrawal entry point and notices about the network's gradual shutdown.

value.detailed_summary_zh:
Blast 于 10 月 26 日到达常规提现界面的截止日期，但其以太坊主网官方跨链桥中仍有约 4041 万美元资产。该金额较 10 月 2 日约 6350 万美元下降约 36%，当日 Blast 宣布将逐步关闭该 Layer 2 网络。

根据 Blast 此前的说明，10 月 26 日之后用户仍可提取资产，但必须直接与以太坊上的桥接合约交互，而不能再依赖常规网站界面。

Blast 已发布 ETH、USDB 和 BLAST 的合约级提现指南；报道描述的流程包括在 Blast 网络发起提现、等待对应状态记录提交至以太坊、通过 OptimismPortal 合约提交提现证明，再经过一天的挑战期并执行最终确认交易。报道发布时，Blast 官网仍显示提现入口及网络逐步关闭的提示。
value.market_impact_en: Around $40 million in ETH, USDB and BLAST remains locked in Blast's Ethereum bridge, so the shift to manual contract-level withdrawals adds friction and delay to redemptions, with released ETH flowing back to mainnet and remaining BLAST liquidity concentrated on venues where holders can exit. The transmission runs through bridge custody and withdrawal throughput rather than through price direction.

value.detailed_summary:
Kimi (Moonshot AI) released K3.1 Pro together with a faster "Highspeed" variant, announced in a blog post at kimi.ai. The launch was paired with a stated policy that the lab will not release open weights that would extend the absolute frontier of offensive cyber capability.

The release makes an explicit safety commitment about which capabilities will be kept closed, a substantive policy position from a Chinese lab known for open-weight releases. Commenters also reported that subscription quotas were exhausted quickly on paid plans.

According to the quoted policy, K3.1 Pro's offensive cyber capability is by design below what Kimi's pipeline can produce and remains behind frontier proprietary models, while the lab says it intends to progressively raise the cyber capability available in open weights. Commenters discussed per-model documentation on kimi.com and third-party model comparison pages.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Kimi (Moonshot AI) released K3.1 Pro together with a faster "Highspeed" variant, announced in a blog post at kimi.ai. The launch was paired with a stated policy that the lab will not release open weights that would extend the absolute frontier of offensive cyber capability.

The release makes an explicit safety commitment about which capabilities will be kept closed, a substantive policy position from a Chinese lab known for open-weight releases. Commenters also reported that subscription quotas were exhausted quickly on paid plans.

According to the quoted policy, K3.1 Pro's offensive cyber capability is by design below what Kimi's pipeline can produce and remains behind frontier proprietary models, while the lab says it intends to progressively raise the cyber capability available in open weights. Commenters discussed per-model documentation on kimi.com and third-party model comparison pages.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Kimi（月之暗面 Moonshot AI）发布 K3.1 Pro，并同时推出速度更快的“高速版”（Highspeed）变体，相关信息发布在 kimi.ai 的博客文章中。此次发布同时附带一项明确政策：不会开源那些会拓展进攻性网络能力绝对前沿的模型权重。

此次发布就哪些能力将被保留为闭源作出了明确的安全承诺，对于一家以开源权重著称的中国实验室而言，这是一个实质性的政策立场。同时有评论者反映，付费订阅套餐的额度很快就被耗尽。

根据被引用的政策表述，K3.1 Pro 的进攻性网络能力在设计上低于其研发管线所能达到的水平，并且仍落后于前沿闭源模型；同时该实验室表示计划逐步提升开源权重中可用的网络能力。评论者还讨论了 kimi.com 上的模型文档以及第三方模型对比页面。
value.market_impact_en: The release matters to the open-weight inference segment: a stronger Kimi model expands the pool of capable models that can be self-hosted or served by third-party providers, which pressures the economics of closed API access. value.background: swETH is Swell's liquid staking token, a tradable receipt for ETH staked on Ethereum that accrues value through a rising exchange rate rather than rebasing; rswETH is the restaked version, whose underlying ETH is also deployed in restaking markets. Because these tokens price via a contract-reported exchange rate, an abnormal rate feeds directly into DeFi valuations and collateral calculations. Swell has expanded from pure liquid staking into restaking as part of its product line.

value.background_zh: swETH 是 Swell 的流动性质押代币，代表在以太坊上质押的 ETH 的可交易凭证，其价值通过不断上升的汇率而非再基准（rebase）来累积；rswETH 则是再质押版本，其底层 ETH 同时被投入再质押市场。由于这类代币通过合约报告的汇率定价，汇率异常会直接影响到 DeFi 估值与抵押品计算。Swell 已从纯粹的流动性质押扩展到再质押业务。
value.detailed_summary:
Ethereum staking protocol Swell has paused deposits and withdrawals for its swETH and rswETH tokens until it corrects the tokens' net asset values and exchange rates. Data showed the swETH and rswETH contracts reporting exchange rates of roughly 1.203 ETH and 1.138 ETH respectively — about 6% and 5% above normal levels.

On-chain analyst Spreek suspected a compromise of the tokens' admin keys and identified a malicious upgrade contract that could affect around 2,500 ETH, which has not yet been executed. Halting deposits and withdrawals means holders of both tokens temporarily cannot redeem them through the protocol.

Swell said no ETH has been transferred out of the affected contracts and that the exact cause remains under investigation. The suspected malicious upgrade had not been executed at the time of reporting.
value.detailed_summary_en:

Data showed the swETH and rswETH contracts reporting exchange rates of roughly 1.203 ETH and 1.138 ETH respectively — about 6% and 5% above normal levels.

On-chain analyst Spreek suspected a compromise of the tokens' admin keys and identified a malicious upgrade contract that could affect around 2,500 ETH, which has not yet been executed. Halting deposits and withdrawals means holders of both tokens temporarily cannot redeem them through the protocol.

Swell said no ETH has been transferred out of the affected contracts and that the exact cause remains under investigation. The suspected malicious upgrade had not been executed at the time of reporting.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
以太坊质押协议 Swell 已暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存款和取款，直至两个代币的净资产值（NAV）与汇率得到修正。数据显示，swETH 与 rswETH 合约报告的汇率分别约为 1.203 ETH 和 1.138 ETH，比正常水平高出约 6% 和 5%。

链上分析师 Spreek 怀疑相关代币的管理私钥已被攻破，并指认出一份可能影响约 2,500 ETH 的恶意升级合约，但该升级尚未被执行。暂停存取款意味着两种代币的持有者暂时无法通过该协议赎回资产。

Swell 表示，目前没有 ETH 从受影响合约中被转出，确切原因仍在调查中。截至报道时，被怀疑的恶意升级尚未执行。
value.market_impact_en: swETH and rswETH are widely used as DeFi collateral, so a paused redemption window plus a mispriced exchange rate can disrupt lending-market valuations and secondary-market pricing for the two tokens while the fix is pending. The flagged exposure of roughly 2,500 ETH is confined to Swell's own contracts rather than a protocol-wide or market-wide event at this stage.
value.market_impact_zh: swETH 与 rswETH 被广泛用作 DeFi 抵押品，因此在修复完成前，赎回通道暂停叠加汇率错报，可能扰动相关借贷市场的估值以及这两种代币的二级市场价格。目前被指出的风险敞口约为 2,500 ETH，局限于 Swell 自身合约，尚不属于波及整个协议或全市场的事件。

value.detailed_summary:
A cryptocurrency exchange initially dismissed a security incident as a false alarm before later acknowledging that it had suffered a $16 million loss, according to Koin Bülteni. The exchange was not identified in the report, and no timeline or technical details of the incident were disclosed.

The reversal from denial to confirmed loss puts the focus on how exchanges communicate during incidents, since initial statements shape how users judge whether their funds are at risk.

The reported loss figure is $16 million. The report does not name the exchange or specify whether user funds, corporate funds or a hot wallet were affected.

value.background: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway (LLM proxy) that puts an AI stack behind one OpenAI-compatible API, routing requests to models such as OpenAI and Anthropic and centrally managing API keys, with self-hosting including air-gapped deployments. This is the second supply chain attack on the project this year, after an earlier incident in March.
value.background_en: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway (LLM proxy) that puts an AI stack behind one OpenAI-compatible API, routing requests to models such as OpenAI and Anthropic and centrally managing API keys, with self-hosting including air-gapped deployments. This is the second supply chain attack on the project this year, after an earlier incident in March.
value.background_zh: LiteLLM 是一款开源 AI 网关（LLM 代理），用一套兼容 OpenAI 的 API 统一接入 AI 技术栈，把请求路由到 OpenAI、Anthropic 等模型，并集中管理 API 密钥，支持包括完全离线在内的自托管部署。这是该项目今年第二次遭遇供应链攻击，今年 3 月就曾因另一场供应链攻击遭到投毒。
value.community_discussion: Hacker News commenters focused on the systemic nature of the problem rather than the single package: one suggested using canarytokens to detect credential theft, another complained that permission pop-up fatigue and routine package installation have desensitized developers to risk, and a third questioned how a project with 55,000 commits in three years could be hit this way. One commenter, citing reports that three unique developer GitHub credentials were compromised, called the pattern systemic and said they would pin LiteLLM to a version before this one until further notice.
value.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters focused on the systemic nature of the problem rather than the single package: one suggested using canarytokens to detect credential theft, another complained that permission pop-up fatigue and routine package installation have desensitized developers to risk, and a third questioned how a project with 55,000 commits in three years could be hit this way. One commenter, citing reports that three unique developer GitHub credentials were compromised, called the pattern systemic and said they would pin LiteLLM to a version before this one until further notice.
value.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的讨论更多聚焦于问题的系统性而非单一软件包：有人建议使用 canarytokens 来检测凭证是否被盗；有人抱怨权限弹窗疲劳和日常化的软件包安装让开发者对风险变得麻木；还有人质疑一个三年内拥有 5.5 万次提交的项目为何会以这种方式被攻破。一位评论者援引“三名开发者的 GitHub 凭证被窃取”的说法，认为这是系统性问题，并表示会把 LiteLLM 固定在更早的版本直到有进一步消息。
value.detailed_summary:
Security firm JFrog found that LiteLLM version 1.107.0 and its official Docker images were compromised in a supply chain attack, with three extra files hidden in the Python package. Once the Python environment starts, the malicious code runs even if LiteLLM is never called, harvesting browser passwords, SSH private keys, AWS and other cloud credentials, and authentication data for tools such as Claude, Codex and Cursor, then sending it to a server disguised as an official domain.

JFrog advises anyone who installed or ran 1.107.0 to treat the related credentials as potentially leaked, isolate and rebuild the environment, and rotate API keys rather than simply uninstalling the software; version 1.106.2 is the confirmed safe rollback. The attacker also left a persistent backdoor that checks for remote instructions once an hour and can download and execute new code.

PyPI has removed the malicious version and Docker Hub has taken down the affected images. The official source code on GitHub does not contain the malicious files, yet all seven platform packages published to PyPI were implanted with the trojan; Docker build records show the release system pulled source from a look-alike repository whose name differs from the official one by a single hyphen, and how it entered the release pipeline remains unclear.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Security firm JFrog found that LiteLLM version 1.107.0 and its official Docker images were compromised in a supply chain attack, with three extra files hidden in the Python package. Once the Python environment starts, the malicious code runs even if LiteLLM is never called, harvesting browser passwords, SSH private keys, AWS and other cloud credentials, and authentication data for tools such as Claude, Codex and Cursor, then sending it to a server disguised as an official domain.

JFrog advises anyone who installed or ran 1.107.0 to treat the related credentials as potentially leaked, isolate and rebuild the environment, and rotate API keys rather than simply uninstalling the software; version 1.106.2 is the confirmed safe rollback. The attacker also left a persistent backdoor that checks for remote instructions once an hour and can download and execute new code.

PyPI has removed the malicious version and Docker Hub has taken down the affected images. The official source code on GitHub does not contain the malicious files, yet all seven platform packages published to PyPI were implanted with the trojan; Docker build records show the release system pulled source from a look-alike repository whose name differs from the official one by a single hyphen, and how it entered the release pipeline remains unclear.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
安全公司 JFrog 发现，热门开源 AI 模型网关 LiteLLM 的 1.107.0 版本及官方 Docker 镜像遭到供应链攻击，Python 安装包中被藏入三个额外文件。用户安装后只要启动相关 Python 环境，即使不调用 LiteLLM，恶意代码也会自动运行，搜集浏览器密码、SSH 私钥、AWS 等云平台凭证，以及 Claude、Codex、Cursor 等工具的认证信息，并发送到伪装成官方域名的服务器。

JFrog 提醒，安装或运行过 1.107.0 的用户应将相关凭证视为可能泄露，隔离并重建环境、轮换 API 密钥等敏感凭证，而不是简单卸载软件；已确认安全的回退版本为 1.106.2。攻击者还留下了一个持久化后门，每小时检查一次远程指令，必要时下载并执行新的代码。

目前 PyPI 已移除恶意版本，Docker Hub 也已撤下受影响镜像。GitHub 上的正式版本源码没有这些恶意文件，但发布到 PyPI 的全部七个平台安装包都被植入木马；社区通过 Docker 构建记录发现，发布系统使用的源码地址指向一个与官方仓库名称只差一个连字符的仿冒仓库，它究竟如何混入发布流程仍未查清。
value.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is credential exposure: self-hosted LiteLLM instances commonly hold model API keys, cloud credentials and SSH keys in their databases and host environments, so crypto and AI-agent teams running such gateways may have had deployment infrastructure credentials exposed, requiring key rotation and environment rebuilds regardless of whether they invoked the library.
value.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是凭证暴露：自托管的 LiteLLM 实例通常在其数据库和主机环境中保存模型 API 密钥、云平台凭证和 SSH 私钥，因此运行此类网关的加密与 AI 智能体团队可能面临部署基础设施凭证外泄的风险，无论是否调用过该库，都需要轮换密钥并重建环境。

Its native bridge is designed to move assets between Initia, its rollups and other blockchains, which made the bridge reserve a single point of dependency for users moving USDC. Bridge exploits have been a recurring attack vector across crypto, with on-chain trackers such as DefiLlama maintaining databases of such incidents.

value.detailed_summary:
Initia suffered a bridge exploit on October 23 that drained its USDC bridge reserve down to $63, with users unable to complete withdrawals. Reporting on the incident states roughly $3 million in real assets exited through bridges against $7 million in unbacked balances.

The reserve depletion left the bridge unable to honor user withdrawals, turning a protocol security breach into a direct loss of access for holders who relied on the bridge to move USDC on and off Initia.

The reported gap between the ~$3 million in real assets that left through bridges and the $7 million in unbacked balances indicates the shortfall exceeds the value actually withdrawn. The incident reduced the USDC bridge reserve to $63.

储备金被抽干使跨链桥无法兑付用户提现，这使一起协议安全事故直接演变为依赖该桥进出 USDC 的持有者的资金可取回性问题。

value.detailed_summary:
OKX's UAE entity has launched tokenised US stock trading that is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, operating under its licence from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA). The offering extends regulated, crypto-style market access to US equity exposure.

A VARA-licensed venue offering round-the-clock tokenised equity exposure widens access to tokenised securities in one of the crypto industry's more developed regulatory jurisdictions, putting equity exposure on the same always-on footing as crypto trading.

Tokenised stocks are blockchain-based tokens designed to reflect the value of a specific equity. Separate reporting on OKX's broader tokenised-equity plans describes trading against stablecoins including USDC, USDG and USDT through permissioned Uniswap v4 liquidity pools on XLayer, OKX's layer-2 blockchain.

OKX 的阿联酋实体已推出代币化美股交易，支持每周 7 天、每天 24 小时不间断交易，并在迪拜虚拟资产监管局（VARA）颁发的牌照下运营。该产品把受监管的、类加密风格的市场准入扩展到了美股敞口。

由 VARA 持牌平台提供全天候代币化股票敞口，意味着在加密行业监管体系较为完善的司法辖区之一，代币化证券的可及性进一步扩大，股票敞口也获得了与加密交易同等的 7×24 小时交易安排。

代币化股票是基于区块链发行的代币，旨在反映某只具体股票的价值。另有关于 OKX 更广泛代币化证券计划的报道提到，相关交易以 USDC、USDG 和 USDT 等稳定币计价，并通过 OKX 二层网络 XLayer 上经许可的 Uniswap v4 流动性池进行。
value.market_impact_en: The launch gives stablecoin holders on a licensed venue a route into US equity exposure, a channel that can pull trading activity toward OKX's UAE platform and the stablecoin pairs such products settle in. It also sets a licensing precedent within VARA's perimeter for how tokenised securities are listed and traded, which is relevant to other venues weighing similar products.

value.detailed_summary:
The NBA announced Monday that Kalshi and Polymarket will become its preferred prediction-market platforms, able to settle NBA-related markets using official league data supplied by Sportradar, use NBA and team marks, and advertise during game broadcasts, while the league retains approval rights over which NBA markets they may list. The league also said it signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC, expanded its existing DraftKings deal to cover prediction markets, and expects similar arrangements with FanDuel and Fanatics in the coming weeks.

The deals give the two platforms official data, league branding and broadcast exposure tied to NBA markets, a level of endorsement a major North American league had not previously extended to prediction-market exchanges. The accompanying CFTC information-sharing agreement adds a regulatory-legitimacy channel alongside the industry's ongoing court fight over federal versus state oversight.

Under the integrity provisions, NBA players, team and league personnel are barred from trading NBA event contracts, and Kalshi and Polymarket must help the league identify suspicious trading, prevent insider trading and share data in investigations. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said the NBA agreement would strengthen information sharing on insider trading and fraud; the NBA joins Major League Baseball and the National Hockey League in establishing such arrangements with the regulator.

这些协议让两家平台在 NBA 相关市场上获得官方数据、联盟品牌授权与转播曝光，这是北美主要职业体育联盟此前未给予预测市场交易所的背书程度。随附的 CFTC 信息共享协议，则在行业围绕联邦与州监管权限的诉讼持续之际，为预测市场增添了一条监管合法性渠道。

在诚信条款下，NBA 球员、球队及联盟工作人员不得交易 NBA 事件合约，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 须协助联盟识别可疑交易、防范内幕交易，并在调查中共享数据。CFTC 主席 Michael S. Selig 表示，与 NBA 的协议将加强针对内幕交易和欺诈的信息共享；NBA 由此加入美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）和北美职业冰球联盟（NHL）的行列，与该监管机构建立类似安排。

The CFTC MOU supports the regulatory-legitimacy side of the trade, but the unresolved state-versus-federal litigation remains a constraint on how far US sports market expansion can proceed.

value.background: The Exponential Time Hypothesis is an unproven computational hardness assumption about how fast Boolean satisfiability can be solved, and it sits alongside the better-known P versus NP problem as a major open question in theoretical computer science. The claim attributed to OpenAI follows a pattern of frontier labs presenting AI-generated mathematical output whose correctness is still being assessed by researchers.

value.background_zh: 指数时间假说是关于布尔可满足性问题求解速度的一个尚未被证明的困难性假设，它与更广为人知的 P 与 NP 问题同属理论计算机科学的重大未解难题。归因于 OpenAI 的这一主张，延续了前沿实验室发布由 AI 生成的数学成果、而其正确性仍待研究者评估的模式。
value.detailed_summary:
TechCrunch published an interview with an MIT computer scientist about OpenAI's claim that its models produced a refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), an unproven hardness assumption in computational complexity theory. The piece is an explanatory interview about the claim rather than the underlying proof or an independent verification of it.

ETH underpins a large body of work on the hardness of satisfiability and on parameterized algorithms, so a valid refutation would unsettle results that assume it. New Scientist reported that, if confirmed, the result would force computer-science textbooks to be rewritten.

ETH, formulated by Impagliazzo and Paturi, states that satisfiability of 3-CNF Boolean formulas cannot be solved in subexponential time; its stronger variant, SETH, asserts that the limiting base-two exponent for k-SAT tends to one as clause width grows. Reports also note that OpenAI has posted a large batch of AI-generated math results of which only a portion has been machine-checked, and that mathematicians say few people understand them yet.

ETH 是大量关于可满足性问题困难性以及参数化算法研究的基础，因此若证伪成立，许多以该假说为前提的结论将受到动摇。《新科学家》报道称，若该结果得到确认，计算机科学教科书将不得不重写。

value.detailed_summary:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in an interview broadcast Friday that he has asked for a plan to use blockchain to help Israel cope with potential future economic sanctions, including restrictions on the country's banking system. Asked whether blockchain could serve as an alternative to sanctions, he said it was one of the options under consideration, but did not identify which agency would lead the work, which blockchain or digital currency would be involved, or any timeline.

The remarks mark a rare case of a sitting prime minister of a U.S.-allied state publicly linking blockchain to sanctions contingency planning, which puts the question of crypto rails for sovereign financial resilience on the record. No policy, budget, or implementing body has been announced.

Netanyahu also warned that U.S. military aid to Israel cannot continue indefinitely and that Israel must reduce its dependence on external support, saying an additional 400 billion shekels (about $129 billion) will be allocated to defense over the coming years along with expanded domestic production of munitions and weapons. The interview aired on Israel's Channel 10, according to reports citing the October 23 broadcast.

以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在周五播出的采访中表示，他已要求制定一项使用区块链的方案，以帮助以色列应对未来可能面临的经济制裁，包括对本国银行体系的限制。当被问及区块链能否作为应对制裁的替代方案时，他回应称这是可考虑的途径之一，但未透露由哪个机构负责、涉及哪条区块链或哪种数字货币，也未给出时间表。

value.detailed_summary:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu drew a public rebuke over a proposal to use cryptocurrency to bypass international economic sanctions. The Bank of Israel issued a rare criticism, saying cryptocurrencies cannot serve as a route around sanctions and that political leaders should focus on policy instead.

The pushback came from Israel's central bank, placing a sitting head of government at odds with his own monetary authority over a tool that sanctions enforcers already treat as a high-risk channel.

The rebuke was described as rare for the Bank of Israel, which argued that crypto cannot function as a sanctions workaround and urged a policy-focused approach instead.

value.background_zh: a16z crypto 自 2013 年起就在各个阶段投资加密与区块链初创公司；今年 5 月的那期基金是其第五只专项加密基金，使其加密领域累计募资额达到 98 亿美元。此次更名之际，比特币年内下跌，资本正与占据主导地位的 AI 交易争夺注意力。同一份简报还提到 BTC 报 81,800 美元、ETH 报 2,400 美元，以及比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元。
value.detailed_summary:
Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund "a16z Frontier" and broadening its mandate to cover AI, autonomous machines and biology, while saying it will continue investing in crypto. Chris Dixon, who has led the crypto team since 2018, runs the new fund alongside Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet.

The firm describes the change as "an expansion" rather than a retreat from crypto, but a fund that was crypto-only will now weigh crypto deals against AI, autonomous machines and biology in the same partner meeting. Dixon's stated rationale is that blockchains have faded into the background of products shipped by Wall Street and fintech firms, so companies should be judged by what they build rather than the underlying plumbing.

The most recent fund size on record is $2.2 billion, announced in May. Dixon has said crypto retains a role in the new mandate — enabling AI agents to pay each other — and points to Oculus, Skydio and Zipline as models for long-horizon bets.
value.detailed_summary_en:
Andreessen Horowitz is renaming its crypto fund "a16z Frontier" and broadening its mandate to cover AI, autonomous machines and biology, while saying it will continue investing in crypto. Chris Dixon, who has led the crypto team since 2018, runs the new fund alongside Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin and Guy Wuollet.

The firm describes the change as "an expansion" rather than a retreat from crypto, but a fund that was crypto-only will now weigh crypto deals against AI, autonomous machines and biology in the same partner meeting. Dixon's stated rationale is that blockchains have faded into the background of products shipped by Wall Street and fintech firms, so companies should be judged by what they build rather than the underlying plumbing.

The most recent fund size on record is $2.2 billion, announced in May. Dixon has said crypto retains a role in the new mandate — enabling AI agents to pay each other — and points to Oculus, Skydio and Zipline as models for long-horizon bets.
value.detailed_summary_zh:
Andreessen Horowitz 将其加密基金更名为“a16z Frontier”，并把投资范围扩大到人工智能、自主机器和生物学，同时表示仍会继续投资加密领域。自 2018 年起负责加密团队的 Chris Dixon 将与 Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz、Eddy Lazzarin 和 Guy Wuollet 共同执掌这只新基金。

该公司称这是一次“扩张”，而非撤离加密领域；但这只原本只做加密的基金，今后将在同一次合伙人会议上把加密交易与人工智能、自主机器和生物学项目放在一起权衡。Dixon 给出的理由是，区块链已淡入华尔街和金融科技公司所交付产品的背景之中，因此应当以公司做了什么来评判，而非其底层技术管道。

有记录的最新一期基金规模为 22 亿美元，于今年 5 月公布。Dixon 表示，加密在新使命中仍有其角色，即让 AI 代理之间能够互相支付；他还以 Oculus、Skydio 和 Zipline 作为长期押注的范例。
value.market_impact_en: The rebrand is a signal about how crypto venture capital allocates capital: if a flagship crypto fund formally widens its remit to AI and biology, crypto startups may face tougher competition for the same partner attention and dollars. The newsletter's simultaneous note of $635 million in bitcoin ETF net outflows reflects a separate channel — spot ETF demand — that has been weighing on sentiment, though the two items are reported side by side rather than as cause and effect.
value.market_impact_zh: 此次更名是加密风险资本配置方式的一个信号：当一只旗舰加密基金正式把职权范围扩大到人工智能和生物学时，加密初创公司可能在争夺同样的合伙人关注与资金时面临更激烈的竞争。简报同时提到比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元，这反映的是另一条渠道，即现货 ETF 需求，它一直在拖累市场情绪；不过这两件事是被并列报道的，而非因果关系。

value.detailed_summary:
Block, Jack Dorsey's company, released a new voice model from its research lab that it says runs locally on a MacBook M4 Max. The company says the model, introduced as Dessa, produces human-like expressions such as laughs, pauses and cries, without cloud inference.

Block presents local execution as the model's defining trait, pointing to audio generation on consumer hardware rather than through cloud inference. The company did not disclose benchmarks, licensing terms, parameter counts or a release date alongside the announcement.

According to Block, Dessa is a full-duplex speech model trained only on speech, rather than on transcribed text paired with audio. The disclosed material centers on demo samples; third-party coverage notes that benchmarks and access status remain undisclosed.

value.current_state_en: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC on October 26, 2026, formally starting its Nasdaq IPO registration under ticker ANT; the filing discloses H1 2026 revenue of $16.3B, a net loss of $80.7B, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as leads, and a warning that it may not achieve or maintain profitability. The S-1 also discloses that Anthropic may issue up to $42B in convertible promissory notes, says existing cash and cash equivalents are sufficient for at least the next 12 months of working capital and other needs, and expects compute and infrastructure expenses to keep increasing and become its largest operating expense. In addition to up to $120.5B in SpaceX AI-related spending commitments through 2029, the S-1 discloses expected payments to Google of up to about $114.5B by 2033 and about $161.2B in Broadcom lease rent (excluding interest), warns that additional financing may be needed sooner, and says pretraining of its next frontier model was delayed more than a month to strengthen safety. The latest disclosures also show that 79% of revenue comes from outside its top five customers, no single customer contributes more than 10% of total revenue, and the company acknowledges it previously significantly underestimated compute demand; Amazon will provide up to $20B in financing under an April agreement, Google has purchased 38.6 million G-2 non-voting redeemable shares, and Anthropic says it has not reached any agreement for a material acquisition.

He said the Hoodi delay bought time but did not solve the issue, that spec changes may ultimately be needed, and called on app developers and auditors to check and report EIP-8037/EIP-8038-related issues.
